quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهَا وَفَرَضْنَٰهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

ٱلزَّانِيَةُ وَٱلزَّانِى فَٱجْلِدُوا۟ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٍۢ مِّنْهُمَا مِا۟ئَةَ جَلْدَةٍۢ ۖ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌۭ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۖ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ٱلزَّانِى لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةًۭ وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌۭ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَٰنِينَ جَلْدَةًۭ وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَهَٰدَةً أَبَدًۭا ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
وَيَدْرَؤُا۟ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو بِٱلْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌۭ مِّنكُمْ ۚ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّۭا لَّكُم ۖ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۚ لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُم مَّا ٱكْتَسَبَ مِنَ ٱلْإِثْمِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ كِبْرَهُۥ مِنْهُمْ لَهُۥ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
لَّوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتُ بِأَنفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًۭا وَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَآ إِفْكٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
لَّوْلَا جَآءُو عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ ۚ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلشُّهَدَآءِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْكَٰذِبُونَ
وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِى مَآ أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُۥ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُۥ هَيِّنًۭا وَهُوَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمٌۭ
وَلَوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَٰذَا سُبْحَٰنَكَ هَٰذَا بُهْتَٰنٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
يَعِظُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُوا۟ لِمِثْلِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةُ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًۭا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزَكِّى مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟ ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتِ ٱلْغَٰفِلَٰتِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ لُعِنُوا۟ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يُوَفِّيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْمُبِينُ

ٱلْخَبِيثَٰتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَٱلْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَٰتِ ۖ وَٱلطَّيِّبَٰتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَٱلطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَٰتِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ ۖ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَأْنِسُوا۟ وَتُسَلِّمُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا۟ فِيهَآ أَحَدًۭا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّىٰ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِن قِيلَ لَكُمُ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟ ۖ هُوَ أَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ
لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍۢ فِيهَا مَتَٰعٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ
قُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَغُضُّوا۟ مِنْ أَبْصَٰرِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُوا۟ فُرُوجَهُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَزْكَىٰ لَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ

وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَٰرِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّ ۖ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُنَّ أَوِ ٱلتَّٰبِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُو۟لِى ٱلْإِرْبَةِ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ أَوِ ٱلطِّفْلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَوْرَٰتِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۖ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّ ۚ وَتُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
وَأَنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْأَيَٰمَىٰ مِنكُمْ وَٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَآئِكُمْ ۚ إِن يَكُونُوا۟ فُقَرَآءَ يُغْنِهِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتَّىٰ يُغْنِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبْتَغُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوهُمْ إِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًۭا ۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مِّن مَّالِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۚ وَلَا تُكْرِهُوا۟ فَتَيَٰتِكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْبِغَآءِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًۭا لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ عَرَضَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَمَن يُكْرِههُّنَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ إِكْرَٰهِهِنَّ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتٍۢ مُّبَيِّنَٰتٍۢ وَمَثَلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةًۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

۞ ٱللَّهُ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِۦ كَمِشْكَوٰةٍۢ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ ۖ ٱلْمِصْبَاحُ فِى زُجَاجَةٍ ۖ ٱلزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌۭ دُرِّىٌّۭ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۢ زَيْتُونَةٍۢ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍۢ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍۢ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِىٓءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌۭ ۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٍۢ ۗ يَهْدِى ٱللَّهُ لِنُورِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلَ لِلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
فِى بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ ٱللَّهُ أَن تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسْمُهُۥ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ فِيهَا بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلْءَاصَالِ
رِجَالٌۭ لَّا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَٰرَةٌۭ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءِ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۙ يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ كَسَرَابٍۭ بِقِيعَةٍۢ يَحْسَبُهُ ٱلظَّمْـَٔانُ مَآءً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَهُۥ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْـًۭٔا وَوَجَدَ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ فَوَفَّىٰهُ حِسَابَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ

أَوْ كَظُلُمَٰتٍۢ فِى بَحْرٍۢ لُّجِّىٍّۢ يَغْشَىٰهُ مَوْجٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ مَوْجٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ سَحَابٌۭ ۚ ظُلُمَٰتٌۢ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ إِذَآ أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُۥ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَىٰهَا ۗ وَمَن لَّمْ يَجْعَلِ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ نُورًۭا فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن نُّورٍ
أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلطَّيْرُ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ ۖ كُلٌّۭ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُۥ وَتَسْبِيحَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزْجِى سَحَابًۭا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ رُكَامًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَٰلِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن جِبَالٍۢ فِيهَا مِنۢ بَرَدٍۢ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُۥ عَن مَّن يَشَآءُ ۖ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِۦ يَذْهَبُ بِٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
يُقَلِّبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ

وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٍۢ مِّن مَّآءٍۢ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰٓ أَرْبَعٍۢ ۚ يَخْلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
لَّقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَٰتٍۢ مُّبَيِّنَٰتٍۢ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
وَيَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَإِذَا دُعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ يَأْتُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ
أَفِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ٱرْتَابُوٓا۟ أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ۚ بَلْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَيَخْشَ ٱللَّهَ وَيَتَّقْهِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
۞ وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِنْ أَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّ ۖ قُل لَّا تُقْسِمُوا۟ ۖ طَاعَةٌۭ مَّعْرُوفَةٌ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

قُلْ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُم مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوا۟ ۚ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمَا ٱسْتَخْلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱرْتَضَىٰ لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًۭا ۚ يَعْبُدُونَنِى لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِى شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِيَسْتَـْٔذِنكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا۟ ٱلْحُلُمَ مِنكُمْ ثَلَٰثَ مَرَّٰتٍۢ ۚ مِّن قَبْلِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنۢ بَعْدِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلْعِشَآءِ ۚ ثَلَٰثُ عَوْرَٰتٍۢ لَّكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا عَلَيْهِمْ جُنَاحٌۢ بَعْدَهُنَّ ۚ طَوَّٰفُونَ عَلَيْكُم بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
وَإِذَا بَلَغَ ٱلْأَطْفَٰلُ مِنكُمُ ٱلْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَـْٔذِنُوا۟ كَمَا ٱسْتَـْٔذَنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ

وَٱلْقَوَٰعِدُ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ٱلَّٰتِى لَا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحًۭا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ أَن يَضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجَٰتٍۭ بِزِينَةٍۢ ۖ وَأَن يَسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّهُنَّ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَن تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ ءَابَآئِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ إِخْوَٰنِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَعْمَٰمِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخْوَٰلِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ خَٰلَٰتِكُمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُۥٓ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَأْكُلُوا۟ جَمِيعًا أَوْ أَشْتَاتًۭا ۚ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُم بُيُوتًۭا فَسَلِّمُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ تَحِيَّةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَٰرَكَةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَإِذَا كَانُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ جَامِعٍۢ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُوهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُونَكَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ فَإِذَا ٱسْتَـْٔذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

لَّا تَجْعَلُوا۟ دُعَآءَ ٱلرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَآءِ بَعْضِكُم بَعْضًۭا ۚ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمْ لِوَاذًۭا ۚ فَلْيَحْذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِۦٓ أَن تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ أَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ

parent_channels.name: [P1 24:1-20] Measure Gives Law a Body

subchannels.name: Enclosed and Placed Revelation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bounded textual unit is delivered, set in its proper rank, incised as a determinate obligation, and made visibly legible.
subchannels.active_motifs: enclosing wall `quranic:root_000758:B002/m01`; enclosed or elevated textual segment `quranic:root_000758:B003/m01`; caused delivery `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; placement in the fitting station `quranic:root_001492:B004/m01`; scored cut `quranic:root_001144:B001/m01`; obligation fixed to a known limit `quranic:root_001144:B002/m01`; manifest disclosure `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`; visible sign `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:1 `سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَاهَا وَفَرَضْنَاهَا ... آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: The legal opening is not only a descent of propositions. It is an architectural and craft process: a unit is enclosed, lowered into position, scored to a fixed measure, and exposed as a visible sign. The imagery supports the primary reading by giving determinate form to revelation's authority.

subchannels.name: Counted Impact on Skin
subchannels.scene_or_process: Exact quantities terminate in a bodily surface where the sanction is materially received.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily skin or hide `quranic:root_000253:B001/m01`; striking that reaches the skin `quranic:root_000253:B004/m01`; completion to one hundred `quranic:root_001394:B002/m01`; eight as the numerical base of eighty `quranic:root_000206:B002/m01`; numerical oneness `quranic:root_001631:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Number and body form one scene rather than two adjacent topics. The count fixes the sanction's extent, while the skin branch identifies its receiving boundary. The latent craft sense of exact completion pressures any reading that would dissolve the stated quantities into an unbounded response.

subchannels.name: The Ordinary Witness Threshold
subchannels.scene_or_process: A charge crosses into adjudicable knowledge only when a fixed number of present observers can articulate it.
subchannels.active_motifs: presence with direct observation `quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`; testimony that declares known fact `quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`; the witness as an articulating tongue `quranic:root_000822:B005/m01`; the number four `quranic:root_000536:B001/m01`; bounded individual unit `quranic:root_001631:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Presence, knowledge, articulation, and count cooperate as a single evidentiary gate. A claim does not become proof merely by circulation; four embodied positions must convert observation into public declaration.

subchannels.name: Reciprocal Oaths as Counterforce
subchannels.scene_or_process: When external witnesses are absent, two opposed oath sequences balance accusation and defense through four repetitions and a decisive fifth.
subchannels.active_motifs: divine name used in oath `quranic:root_000047:B002/m01`; the number four `quranic:root_000536:B001/m01`; the fifth that completes the series `quranic:root_000439:B001/m01`; mutual imprecation between spouses `quranic:root_001359:B004/m01`; averting a penalty by counter-proof `quranic:root_000466:B001/m01`; wrath surging toward requital `quranic:root_001092:B001/m01`; the self as the sole available witness `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`; punishment as inflicted pain `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:6 `إِلَّا أَنفُسُهُمْ ... أَرْبَعُ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ`; 24:7 `وَالْخَامِسَةُ ... لَعْنَتَ اللَّهِ`; 24:8 `وَيَدْرَأُ عَنْهَا الْعَذَابَ`; 24:9 `وَالْخَامِسَةَ ... غَضَبَ اللَّهِ`
subchannels.synthesis: The oath procedure is a calibrated counterweight, not a loose appeal to sincerity. Four units establish symmetry; the fifth changes the stakes; the answering sequence actively deflects punishment. Lexical imprecation makes the legal form reciprocal and self-binding.

subchannels.name: Mis-Scaled Moral Accounting
subchannels.scene_or_process: Each participant acquires an individual liability, one actor shoulders its largest share, and speech judged light nearby is registered as great at the decisive station.
subchannels.active_motifs: the individual person `quranic:root_001409:B001/m01`; self-acquired gain or liability `quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`; the greatest portion of an affair `quranic:root_001281:B002/m01`; lightness and ease `quranic:root_001608:B002/m01`; magnitude and force `quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`; a grave descending event `quranic:root_001029:B004/m01`; nearness at a place of judgment `quranic:root_001052:B004/m01`; requital of sin `quranic:root_000013:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:11 `لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ ... مَا اكْتَسَبَ ... تَوَلَّى كِبْرَهُ`; 24:15 `تَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِندَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ`
subchannels.synthesis: The rumor has an allocation structure: distributed acquisition, a largest share, and a final scale. What feels frictionless in the mouth becomes a weighty event at the adjudicating proximity marked by `عِندَ اللَّهِ`. The channel reframes casual transmission as measurable participation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A norm becomes effective by being bounded, placed, counted, witnessed, and finally registered at its proper moral magnitude.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:1-15 anchors the invariant in `سُورَةٌ`, `فَرَضْنَاهَا`, the counted sanctions, the four/fivefold testimony cycles, and the contrast `هَيِّنًا ... عَظِيمٌ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Lexical branches make legislation spatial and corporeal: a surah resembles an enclosing wall, obligation a scored cut, punishment a measured impact on skin, and culpability an allocated share whose apparent and actual sizes diverge.

parent_channels.name: [P1 24:1-20] Speech Moves as a Physical Force

subchannels.name: Accusation as Projectile Injury
subchannels.scene_or_process: A verbal charge is launched toward a protected target, reaches listeners through abusive sound, and leaves a wound-like mark.
subchannels.active_motifs: launching an object `quranic:root_000603:B001/m01`; projectile, point, or struck quarry `quranic:root_000603:B003/m01`; verbal accusation `quranic:root_000603:B008/m01`; inaccurate shot of judgment `quranic:root_000603:B009/m01`; shield or practice target `quranic:root_000466:B005/m01`; abusive speech made audible `quranic:root_000741:B006/m01`; bodily wound `quranic:root_001316:B003/m01`; taking or attacking someone by the tongue `quranic:root_001355:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The charge inherits the mechanics of a shot: projection, target, possible mis-aim, reception, and injury. The protected person is not merely discussed but struck in a social body, while the tongue functions as the attacking instrument and hearing as the point of impact.

subchannels.name: Tongue-to-Mouth Relay
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech is taken at one bodily interface and immediately reissued from another, producing a relay without a knowledge-bearing pause.
subchannels.active_motifs: tongue as speech organ `quranic:root_001355:B001/m01`; tongue as message carrier `quranic:root_001355:B008/m01`; receiving and learning words `quranic:root_001372:B011/m01`; mouth as opening `quranic:root_001190:B001/m01`; opening the mouth in speech `quranic:root_001190:B003/m01`; voiced utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; auditory reception `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:15 `تَلَقَّوْنَهُ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم`; 24:16 `إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُم`
subchannels.synthesis: The verse's unusual tongue reception becomes a literal transfer mechanism in the branch network. Words are caught, carried, and emitted through organs of speech before knowledge enters the circuit, explaining how repetition can outrun verification.

subchannels.name: Discourse as Overflow
subchannels.scene_or_process: A filled source spills beyond its boundary, and the released material diffuses as circulating talk.
subchannels.active_motifs: liquid filling and easy overflow `quranic:root_001192:B001/m01`; expansive immersion in talk `quranic:root_001192:B003/m01`; diffusion among people `quranic:root_000836:B003/m01`; circulating public talk `quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Overflow and rumor share one process signature: pressure exceeds containment, then material disperses through a population. The hydrological image clarifies that the wrong is not only the proposition's content but the uncontrolled expansion of its carrier medium.

subchannels.name: Rumor as a Fire Fed by a Group
subchannels.scene_or_process: A compact supporting group feeds a fire whose sparks scatter outward, turning collective reinforcement into wider social ignition.
subchannels.active_motifs: group gathered around and mutually supporting `quranic:root_001018:B004/m01`; diffusion among people `quranic:root_000836:B003/m01`; feeding and strengthening a fire `quranic:root_000836:B005/m01`; flying sparks `quranic:root_000787:B003/m01`; manifest obscenity that exceeds a boundary `quranic:root_001134:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:11 `عُصْبَةٌ مِنكُمْ`; 24:19 `أَن تَشِيعَ الْفَاحِشَةُ`
subchannels.synthesis: This is not the fluid mechanism of accidental overflow. Here a group supplies fuel and mutual reinforcement, after which sparks distribute the injury. The image usefully pressures the collective's role: proximity and solidarity can become an engine of escalation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An utterance can be launched, received, relayed, spilled, and intensified; social speech therefore behaves like force moving through material media.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct and indirect; 24:4-6 supplies `يَرْمُونَ`, 24:12-16 hearing/tongue/mouth transfer, and 24:14/19 overflow and diffusion.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The network materializes accusation as projectile injury and rumor as both fluid overflow and fire propagation, exposing distinct mechanisms rather than one generic “speech” domain.

parent_channels.name: [P1 24:1-20] Reputation Has an Enclosure, Breach, and Repair

subchannels.name: Fortified Chastity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Chastity occupies a defended interior protected by fortification, inviolable precinct, and covering.
subchannels.active_motifs: preservation inside an encircling fort `quranic:root_000331:B001/m01`; guarded sexual integrity `quranic:root_000331:B002/m01`; inviolable precinct and its protected margin `quranic:root_000313:B003/m01`; protected right or sanctity `quranic:root_000313:B006/m01`; a cover that shields what is beneath it `quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The protected woman and the protected claim about her become one fortified scene. Chastity is an interior condition, prohibition marks its perimeter, and covering prevents destructive exposure. The spatial model explains why unsupported accusation is treated as boundary violation.

subchannels.name: Shell-Break and Exposure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Obscene speech crosses a fixed perimeter and forces what was enclosed outward, like fruit breaking through its husk.
subchannels.active_motifs: exceeding a proper limit `quranic:root_001134:B002/m01`; obscene speech or action `quranic:root_001134:B003/m01`; a ripe date exiting its shell `quranic:root_001156:B002/m01`; false charge that stuns its target or hearer `quranic:root_000157:B002/m01`; the protected sexual interior `quranic:root_000331:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:4 `الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ... الْفَاسِقُونَ`; 24:16 `بُهْتَانٌ عَظِيمٌ`; 24:19 `تَشِيعَ الْفَاحِشَةُ`
subchannels.synthesis: Transgression is rendered as forced emergence through a protective casing. The husk image makes `فسق` a structural exit, while obscene and stunning speech enact the pressure that breaches the enclosure. The result is exposure, not just doctrinal error.

subchannels.name: Repair, Reconciliation, and Protective Cover
subchannels.scene_or_process: After breach, return is invited, damaged relations are repaired, hostility is removed, and consequence is covered.
subchannels.active_motifs: repair opposed to corruption `quranic:root_000876:B001/m01`; reconciliation that removes estrangement `quranic:root_000876:B002/m01`; inviting another to return in repentance `quranic:root_000189:B003/m01`; covering fault and shielding its bearer from consequence `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; merciful tenderness `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`; unowed restorative gift `quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`; declaration of absolution `quranic:root_000666:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Repair is multi-step: an offender turns, a relationship is made fit, the fault is covered, and mercy supplies more than bare equilibrium. The absolving force of `سُبْحَانَكَ` also interrupts the rumor by clearing the divine frame of the attributed obscenity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sexual reputation is treated as an inhabited protected interior whose boundary can be crossed, whose covering can split, and whose integrity can be restored.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct and indirect; 24:3-5 and 24:19 anchor chastity, prohibition, transgression, repentance, and repair.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fort, precinct, shell, cover, and wound-relapse senses turn abstract honor into boundary maintenance and make repentance a practical reconstruction rather than a merely verbal reversal.

parent_channels.name: [P1 24:1-20] Cognition Can Align or Invert a Report

subchannels.name: A Gradient from Inference to Suspicion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A heard report moves through increasingly unstable mental estimates, from inference by a sign to weak imagining, accusation, and habitual mistrust.
subchannels.active_motifs: conviction inferred from an indicator `quranic:root_000969:B001/m01`; weak supposition `quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`; accusatory suspicion `quranic:root_000969:B004/m01`; habitual ill opinion of others `quranic:root_000969:B005/m01`; estimating something in the mind `quranic:root_000318:B002/m01`; believing a report so the heart settles `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:11 `لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا`; 24:12 `سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ... خَيْرًا`; 24:15 `تَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is a decision ladder, not a single state called opinion. The same input may be interpreted through a trustworthy indicator, held as weak conjecture, converted into an accusation, or generalized into a disposition toward others. The commanded good judgment is therefore an active epistemic choice.

subchannels.name: Falsehood as Directional Inversion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A statement is turned off its proper heading, stabilized as a lie, and then used to classify other speakers as liars.
subchannels.active_motifs: turning something away from its face or direction `quranic:root_000041:B001/m01`; lie diverted from truth `quranic:root_000041:B002/m01`; judgment weakened and deprived of sound strategy `quranic:root_000041:B006/m01`; falsehood opposed to truth `quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`; assigning falsehood to another `quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: `إفك` is not only incorrect content; it is an orientation reversed. Once the report is turned, cognition loses strategic soundness and social actors begin projecting the false classification onto others. The channel makes moral error a directional operation.

subchannels.name: Inner Speech Meets Exposed Knowledge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Unvoiced formulation and inward intention are contrasted with articulated disclosure and knowledge that fully uncovers its object.
subchannels.active_motifs: speech formed internally before utterance `quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`; speech as held conviction or doctrine `quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`; mind, intention, and discriminating faculty within the self `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`; knowledge as the object's disclosure to the knower `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; meaning exposed through word or sign `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`; right-aiming wisdom `quranic:root_000348:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:12 `بِأَنفُسِهِمْ ... وَقَالُوا`; 24:15 `مَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ`; 24:18-19 `يُبَيِّنُ ... عَلِيمٌ ... اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ`
subchannels.synthesis: The decisive boundary lies between what the self formulates, what the mouth releases, and what is actually known. Disclosure is legitimate when it unveils meaning; rumor instead externalizes an inner formulation without the corresponding disclosure of fact.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Before speech becomes public judgment, the mind estimates, orients, and either aligns a report with evidence or turns it away from truth.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:11-19 repeatedly opposes supposition, calculation, inner judgment, manifest falsehood, and divine knowledge.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The branches distinguish several epistemic operations concealed by broad labels such as “thinking”: strong inference, weak imagining, accusation, habitual suspicion, internal speech, and directional inversion.

parent_channels.name: [P1 24:1-20] Accusation Pressures Reproductive Continuity

subchannels.name: Pairing, Contract, and Sexual Contact
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two persons are paired through a recognized marital relation whose protected interior includes sexual contact.
subchannels.active_motifs: spouse in a marital pair `quranic:root_000652:B002/m01`; joining one thing as the mate of another `quranic:root_000652:B003/m01`; sexual intercourse `quranic:root_001548:B001/m01`; marriage contract `quranic:root_001548:B002/m01`; marriage as a protecting status `quranic:root_000331:B003/m01`; sexual contact `quranic:root_001423:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Contract, pairing, protected status, and bodily contact form one social-reproductive frame. The latent sexual sense of touch at 24:14 does not replace the surface meaning of affliction; it resonates with the marital field already active and sharpens what an accusation puts at risk.

subchannels.name: Gestation and Birth Leave Evidence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A womb receives conception, carries a child, releases birth material, and is attended by recognizable traces and a receiving agent.
subchannels.active_motifs: womb as the child's growing enclosure `quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`; pregnancy and postpartum emergence `quranic:root_001533:B005/m01`; blood or membrane accompanying birth as a witness `quranic:root_000822:B006/m01`; afterbirth and uterine discharge `quranic:root_000994:B009/m01`; midwife receiving the newborn `quranic:root_001198:B007/m01`; rapid conception `quranic:root_001372:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The branch network assembles a complete reproductive sequence from roots otherwise active in mercy, selfhood, witness, punishment, reception, and verbal relay. This scene usefully reframes why proof rules guard lineage: birth itself yields bodily witnesses, while rumor tries to manufacture social evidence without them.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sexual accusation reaches beyond an isolated act into pairing, marital legitimacy, conception, gestation, birth, and the traces by which lineage becomes socially visible.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 24:3-14 supplies marriage, spouses, chastity, self-witness, testimony, mercy, and bodily contact, while the reproductive sequence remains lexically latent.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Womb, postpartum blood, afterbirth, birth witness, midwife, and rapid conception branches disclose the lineage stakes that make sexual testimony unusually consequential.

parent_channels.name: [P2 24:21-34] Deviation Leaves a Track

subchannels.name: Stepwise Pursuit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A walker places successive steps; another traces them one by one until the path produces a binding consequence.
subchannels.active_motifs: stride and distance between feet `quranic:root_000424:B001/m01`; footprints treated as a path to imitate `quranic:root_000424:B002/m01`; stepping past a boundary `quranic:root_000424:B004/m01`; following an actor or trace `quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`; searching footprint after footprint `quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`; uninterrupted succession `quranic:root_000175:B004/m01`; consequence that follows and remains due `quranic:root_000175:B006/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:21 `لَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ ... وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَاتِ`
subchannels.synthesis: The warning describes a process with temporal granularity. Each small imitation supplies the location of the next; repeated following becomes continuity, and continuity leaves a liability behind it. The danger lies in the chain, not only its endpoint.

subchannels.name: The Long Tether of Rebellion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A remote, rebellious agent pulls from a distance through a long, tightly twisted line whose crooked heading resists the intended course.
subchannels.active_motifs: remoteness and severance `quranic:root_000796:B001/m01`; long tightly twisted rope `quranic:root_000796:B002/m01`; crooked divergence and opposition `quranic:root_000796:B003/m01`; insolent rebel `quranic:root_000796:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:21 `الشَّيْطَانِ` (twice)
subchannels.synthesis: The satanic figure carries a mechanical image distinct from the follower's footsteps. Distance does not remove control: a long tether can transmit pull, and its crooked tension biases every subsequent step. The image materializes remote influence without collapsing it into compulsion.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Moral deviation is spatially enacted as a traceable sequence and as distance maintained by a taut, crooked line.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct and indirect; 24:21 repeats `تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Footprints, stepwise tracking, a long well-rope, and crooked tension separate the incremental mechanism of following from the deviant condition of the leader followed.

parent_channels.name: [P2 24:21-34] Pardon Removes Residue and Reopens Kinship

subchannels.name: Erasing the Trace
subchannels.scene_or_process: Punitive pursuit stops, the residual mark is worn away, and the offender is covered against the fault's continuing effect.
subchannels.active_motifs: leaving deserved punishment `quranic:root_001032:B001/m01`; wind or time erasing a track `quranic:root_001032:B006/m01`; protective covering `quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`; covering fault and shielding its bearer `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:22 `وَلْيَعْفُوا ... أَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ ... غَفُورٌ`
subchannels.synthesis: Pardon first changes the offense's persistence. The pursuer releases punishment, then the trace by which the offense remains socially retraceable is erased, and protective covering prevents continued exposure. These are successive operations, not synonyms.

subchannels.name: Turning the Broad Side Away
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person withdraws the accusing face from the fault and converts confrontation into an open-handed social closure.
subchannels.active_motifs: broad face or side `quranic:root_000867:B001/m01`; graceful turning away from fault `quranic:root_000867:B002/m01`; joining palm to palm `quranic:root_000867:B004/m01`; the rejected alternative of turning away a petitioner `quranic:root_000867:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The face branch gives pardon a bodily orientation: one ceases presenting the fault as the object of confrontation. The hand-contact branch extends that turn into renewed social contact, while refusal of a petitioner remains the live contrary outcome in the verse's gift context.

subchannels.name: Provision Re-enters the Kin Network
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material capacity is redirected toward a near relative after estrangement, restoring both support and relational proximity.
subchannels.active_motifs: blood kinship `quranic:root_001212:B003/m01`; kinship as a womb-derived bond `quranic:root_000552:B002/m01`; capacity beyond immediate need `quranic:root_001163:B001/m01`; unowed gift `quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`; giving or bringing a grant `quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`; nearness opposed to distance `quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:22 `أُولُو الْفَضْلِ وَالسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوا أُولِي الْقُرْبَى`
subchannels.synthesis: The social repair becomes complete only when resources move again. Proximity is not sentimental: the kin bond creates a route, capacity supplies the material, and giving reopens a connection that resentment had threatened to close.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Forgiveness clears the material trace of offense, changes bodily orientation toward the offender, and permits provision to flow again through a damaged kin relation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct and indirect; 24:22 joins `يَعْفُوا`, `يَصْفَحُوا`, `يَغْفِرَ`, kinship, capacity, and giving.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Wind-erased tracks, a broad face turned away from blame, a joined hand, and protective covering distinguish complementary operations often compressed into a single idea of pardon.

parent_channels.name: [P2 24:21-34] Speech Becomes Bodily and Moral Evidence

subchannels.name: Speaking Limbs Return the Charge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A verbal projectile aimed at a protected person is answered when the accuser's own organs become witnesses to deliberate action.
subchannels.active_motifs: verbal accusation `quranic:root_000603:B008/m01`; guarded chastity `quranic:root_000331:B002/m01`; testimony that declares known fact `quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`; tongue as speaking organ `quranic:root_001355:B001/m01`; hand as bodily instrument `quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`; foot or leg `quranic:root_000546:B001/m01`; intended deed `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:23 `يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ`; 24:24 `تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ`
subchannels.synthesis: The accusation reverses direction. Organs formerly used to transmit or enact it cease being private instruments and become public declarants. The body closes the evidentiary gap that rumor attempted to exploit.

subchannels.name: Words and Persons Are Sorted by Quality
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bad speech, bad action, and corrupt companionship collect on one side; wholesome persons and expressions collect on the other.
subchannels.active_motifs: intrinsic vileness extending to false words and ugly deeds `quranic:root_000386:B001/m01`; corruption reinforced by corrupt companions `quranic:root_000386:B003/m01`; wholesomeness opposed to corruption `quranic:root_000961:B001/m01`; purification from contaminating matter `quranic:root_000961:B003/m01`; falsely attributing unsaid words `quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`; circulating public talk `quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:26 `الْخَبِيثَاتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ ... وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ ... مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ`
subchannels.synthesis: The pairing is a sorting operation whose inputs include utterances, actions, associates, and persons. It does not merely label two static classes; it shows how speech finds a sustaining moral environment and how purification separates a person from contaminating attribution.

subchannels.name: Exoneration Opens Honorable Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separation from a false attribution is followed by protective covering and an apportioned, honorable gift.
subchannels.active_motifs: exonerating separation from person, deed, or defect `quranic:root_000099:B002/m01`; covering fault and consequence `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; apportioned provision `quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`; nourishing provision `quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`; intrinsic honor and generosity `quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`; what is precious to its holder `quranic:root_001294:B010/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:26 `مُبَرَّءُونَ ... لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ`
subchannels.synthesis: Exoneration is a release operation, after which covering prevents the lie's residue from adhering. Provision then restores both material share and social honor. The outcome is not simply innocence but a renewed allocation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Accusatory speech returns through bodies, is sorted by moral quality, and terminates in exoneration or allocated consequence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct and indirect; 24:23-26 proceeds from accusation of protected women to bodily testimony, truth disclosed, qualitative pairing, exoneration, forgiveness, and honorable provision.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Tongues, hands, and feet turn discourse into embodied evidence, while purity and corruption branches classify not only persons but words, deeds, and the company that sustains them.

parent_channels.name: [P2 24:21-34] Apertures Govern Access

subchannels.name: Threshold Recognition, Permission, and Reversal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visitor reaches an inhabited boundary, establishes recognition, receives or lacks authorization, and reverses course when refused.
subchannels.active_motifs: house as dwelling `quranic:root_000166:B001/m01`; entry into an interior `quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`; inward secret or hidden side `quranic:root_000464:B003/m01`; authorization from a gatekeeper `quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`; detecting another by sight, hearing, or felt presence `quranic:root_000059:B002/m01`; inhabitants joined by dwelling `quranic:root_000064:B001/m01`; return to the point of origin `quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`; a spoken answer sent back `quranic:root_000544:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:27 `لَا تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتًا ... حَتَّى تَسْتَأْنِسُوا ... عَلَى أَهْلِهَا`; 24:28 `حَتَّى يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ ... ارْجِعُوا فَارْجِعُوا`; 24:29 `بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: Entry is a reversible protocol, not a one-way physical motion. Recognition tests whether an interior is socially available; permission opens it; refusal returns both message and visitor. The hidden-interior branch clarifies what the threshold protects.

subchannels.name: Gaze as an Attenuated Valve
subchannels.scene_or_process: Visual intake is deliberately reduced while vigilance maintains the boundary against accidental overreach.
subchannels.active_motifs: ocular seeing `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; lowering or diminishing a faculty `quranic:root_001093:B001/m01`; guarding and sustained care `quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`; alert self-restraint against slips `quranic:root_000342:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:30-31 `يَغُضُّوا/يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِمْ/أَبْصَارِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظُوا/يَحْفَظْنَ`
subchannels.synthesis: Lowering the gaze is a controlled reduction, like restricting flow through an opening; it is not the abolition of sight. Guarding supplies the sustained attention required to keep that reduction stable in changing encounters.

subchannels.name: The Body as a Vulnerable Opening
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bodily opening resembles a gap in a wall or exposed frontier that requires inspection and defense.
subchannels.active_motifs: gap or slit between two things `quranic:root_001139:B001/m01`; sexual opening `quranic:root_001139:B003/m01`; exposed frontier between safety and danger `quranic:root_001139:B004/m01`; recurrent exposure of what should be covered `quranic:root_001139:B007/m01`; private nakedness or secluded time `quranic:root_001060:B002/m01`; uncovered defect in house, garment, or frontier `quranic:root_001060:B003/m01`; defense of private sanctity `quranic:root_000342:B006/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:30-31 `وَيَحْفَظُوا/يَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُمْ/فُرُوجَهُنَّ`; 24:31 `عَوْرَاتِ النِّسَاءِ`
subchannels.synthesis: The sexual sense remains primary, but the lexical field gives it defensive geometry. An opening can be structurally necessary and still vulnerable; guarding is therefore maintenance of a frontier, not denial that the aperture exists.

subchannels.name: Garment Closure Over the Opening
subchannels.scene_or_process: A covering is drawn across a garment aperture so that adornment does not pass from hidden to displayed state.
subchannels.active_motifs: covering or veil `quranic:root_000438:B001/m01`; concealment inside a sheltering cover `quranic:root_000438:B004/m01`; garment neckline or opening `quranic:root_000283:B001/m01`; making beauty externally visible `quranic:root_000660:B002/m01`; adornment as worn object `quranic:root_000660:B003/m01`; emergence from concealment `quranic:root_000097:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:31 `لَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ ... وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَى جُيُوبِهِنَّ`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is a precise closure operation: a covering is redirected onto an existing opening, changing the path by which adornment becomes visible. It complements bodily guarding but remains a distinct garment mechanism.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Houses, eyes, bodily openings, and garments are apertures whose ethical function depends on controlled entry, attenuation, guarding, and closure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:27-31 moves from house entry and permission to lowered sight, guarded openings, displayed adornment, covering, and the garment opening.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Doorway protocol and bodily modesty become structurally homologous without being collapsed: each has an exterior, an interior, an aperture, an authorized user, and a reversible access operation.

parent_channels.name: [P2 24:21-34] Visibility Rights Follow Social Roles

subchannels.name: Marital and Kin Roles
subchannels.scene_or_process: A household graph links spouses, parents, siblings, and descendants through distinct forms of formation, nurture, intimacy, and lineage.
subchannels.active_motifs: husband in a marital relation `quranic:root_000134:B001/m01`; intimate marital companionship `quranic:root_000134:B005/m01`; fatherhood as generation and nurture `quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`; sibling kinship `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`; filiation and descent `quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`; women as a social class `quranic:root_001500:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:31 `لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ آبَائِهِنَّ ... أَوْ أَبْنَائِهِنَّ ... أَوْ إِخْوَانِهِنَّ ... أَوْ نِسَائِهِنَّ`
subchannels.synthesis: The permissions are indexed to differentiated relations, not an undifferentiated category of familiarity. Each role carries a distinct social history—generation, descent, siblinghood, or marital intimacy—that makes proximity intelligible.

subchannels.name: Dependence, Need, and Childhood
subchannels.scene_or_process: Access narrows or widens according to dependency and whether sexual need or perceptual maturity is active.
subchannels.active_motifs: child at an early life stage `quranic:root_000942:B001/m01`; child-bearing companionship and care `quranic:root_000942:B002/m01`; urgent need including sexual need `quranic:root_000024:B001/m01`; owned dependent under another's disposal `quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`; ordinary following or service `quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`; the contrary follower who pursues women `quranic:root_000175:B011/m01`; adult man as a sexed role `quranic:root_000546:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:31 `مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُنَّ أَوِ التَّابِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُولِي الْإِرْبَةِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ أَوِ الطِّفْلِ`
subchannels.synthesis: The list is a functional risk map. Dependency alone does not settle the relation; need, pursuit, sexed role, and childhood awareness alter how a follower participates in the scene. The contrary branch of “following women” sharpens why lack of `إربة` matters.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Proximity does not authorize visibility by physical nearness alone; named kinship, marital, dependency, age, and desire roles determine the access relation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:31 enumerates husbands, ascendants, descendants, siblings, women, dependents, followers without sexual need, and children below awareness.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The branches expose role mechanics inside the list: marital play and mutual accommodation, parental formation, dependent ownership, felt need, and the dangerous counter-image of a follower who pursues women.

parent_channels.name: [P2 24:21-34] Marriage Converts Lack into Household Capacity

subchannels.name: From Unpaired Status to Contracted Pair
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person lacking a spouse is actively brought into a recognized marital bond.
subchannels.active_motifs: interruption of spousal pairing `quranic:root_000073:B001/m01`; causing another to enter marriage `quranic:root_001548:B003/m01`; marriage contract `quranic:root_001548:B002/m01`; acquisition of marital affiliation `quranic:root_001548:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:32 `وَأَنكِحُوا الْأَيَامَى مِنكُمْ`; 24:33 `لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا`
subchannels.synthesis: The unpaired state is not treated as an essence. A communal causative act and a legal bond convert it into affiliation. The operation distributes responsibility beyond the prospective spouses alone.

subchannels.name: Poverty Becomes Sufficiency
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material need is met by an enlarging gift that makes a household viable, with marriage itself functioning as a form of sufficiency.
subchannels.active_motifs: material poverty and need `quranic:root_001169:B002/m01`; material independence `quranic:root_001110:B001/m01`; functional sufficiency `quranic:root_001110:B002/m01`; marriage as enrichment and protection `quranic:root_001110:B006/m01`; breadth of means `quranic:root_001647:B003/m01`; unowed divine gift `quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:32 `إِن يَكُونُوا فُقَرَاءَ يُغْنِهِمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ`; 24:33 `حَتَّى يُغْنِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ`
subchannels.synthesis: Enrichment is not reducible to cash accumulation. It includes enough function, widened capacity, and the stabilizing relation created by marriage. The sequence reframes economic lack as a condition that can be transformed rather than a permanent bar.

subchannels.name: Restrained Waiting
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person unable to reach marriage holds desire within a guarded boundary until capacity changes.
subchannels.active_motifs: restraining oneself from what is improper `quranic:root_001031:B001/m01`; guarded sexual integrity `quranic:root_000331:B002/m01`; gentle pacing and delay `quranic:root_000610:B005/m01`; practical easing of hardship `quranic:root_001647:B005/m01`; useful good sought in the interim `quranic:root_000452:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:32 `وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ`; 24:33 `وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتَّى يُغْنِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ ... إِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا`
subchannels.synthesis: Waiting is an active containment scene with a specified terminus, not indefinite suspension. Restraint protects the sexual boundary while gradual easing and recognized good prepare a changed material state.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Marriage is a transition from unpaired status toward a protected household, mediated by resources, sufficiency, and restraint during delay.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:32-33 joins the unpaired, arranged marriage, poverty, divine enrichment, inability to find marriage, and chastity.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sufficiency branches explicitly treat marriage itself as enrichment and fortification, while patient delay appears as a controlled temporal operation rather than passive exclusion.

parent_channels.name: [P2 24:21-34] Dependent Status Can Be Written Toward Release or Forced Toward Exploitation

subchannels.name: The Emancipation Contract
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separated terms are joined into writing, made binding, and directed toward release from owned status.
subchannels.active_motifs: joining parts into one construction `quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`; inscribed document `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; binding legal determination `quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`; manumission contract for staged payment `quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`; owned human status `quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`; enslaved person opposed to the free `quranic:root_000973:B001/m01`; enslaved youth or servant `quranic:root_001130:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:32 `عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَائِكُمْ`; 24:33 `يَبْتَغُونَ الْكِتَابَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوهُمْ`
subchannels.synthesis: The four writing senses form a procedural sequence: assemble terms, record them, give them binding force, and orient performance toward freedom. The contract is therefore a machine for changing status, not merely a document about it.

subchannels.name: Capital Transfers Capacity
subchannels.scene_or_process: The party holding resources transfers part of that capacity so the dependent can perform the release agreement.
subchannels.active_motifs: accumulated property `quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`; giving and delivery `quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`; unowed material gift `quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`; generosity as a gift-bearing quality `quranic:root_000452:B005/m01`; beneficial good recognized in another `quranic:root_000452:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:33 `إِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا وَآتُوهُم مِّن مَّالِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي آتَاكُمْ`
subchannels.synthesis: Contract alone cannot alter status if all capacity remains with the owner. Granting money redistributes the means of performance and makes the written route materially traversable. The verse locates the owner's capital inside a prior chain of giving.

subchannels.name: Coerced Sexual Extraction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A controller overrides another's aversion, presses her toward prostitution, and seeks a worldly return from the forced act.
subchannels.active_motifs: natural or moral aversion `quranic:root_001295:B001/m01`; forcing another to do what she rejects `quranic:root_001295:B003/m01`; aggressive transgression `quranic:root_000138:B003/m01`; prostitution and sexual exploitation `quranic:root_000138:B005/m01`; pressuring another's will `quranic:root_000610:B002/m01`; worldly commodity or compensating return `quranic:root_001001:B008/m01`; protective chastity `quranic:root_000331:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:33 `وَلَا تُكْرِهُوا فَتَيَاتِكُمْ عَلَى الْبِغَاءِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًا لِّتَبْتَغُوا عَرَضَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا`
subchannels.synthesis: This is the inverse of funded release. The controlling party extracts value by defeating another's will and protective boundary. Keeping aversion, coercion, sexual transgression, and worldly return distinct reveals the full transaction rather than hiding it inside a broad category of immorality.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Power over dependents takes opposite procedural forms: a written, funded route out of ownership or coercive conversion of another's body into worldly return.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct and indirect; 24:33 places emancipation contract, owned status, monetary grant, coercion, prostitution, chastity, and worldly goods in one contested field.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Writing branches assemble, inscribe, bind, and finally emancipate; coercion branches instead override aversion and turn sexual violation into an extractive transaction.

parent_channels.name: [P2 24:21-34] Revelation Projects Precedent into the Present

subchannels.name: Signs Delivered into Legibility
subchannels.scene_or_process: Signs are brought down, set in their proper position, made visible, and articulated so their meaning can be recognized.
subchannels.active_motifs: caused delivery from above `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; placing material in its fitting rank `quranic:root_001492:B004/m01`; visible sign `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`; manifest disclosure `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`; disclosure by word or marker `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:34 `أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ آيَاتٍ مُّبَيِّنَاتٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: Delivery and explanation are separate operations. The signs arrive, occupy a fitting place in the present situation, become perceptible, and then disclose what they mean. The sequence prevents “clarity” from being treated as an unmediated property detached from placement and address.

subchannels.name: Prior Case as Affective Warning
subchannels.scene_or_process: A completed prior generation is fashioned into a portable comparison whose present recognition moves the heart toward caution.
subchannels.active_motifs: exemplary saying projected onto another case `quranic:root_001397:B003/m01`; example as sign and lesson `quranic:root_001397:B011/m01`; a generation that has passed away `quranic:root_000436:B003/m01`; temporal precedence `quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`; admonition that warns and softens the heart `quranic:root_001663:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:34 `مَثَلًا مِّنَ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةً`
subchannels.synthesis: The past is not retained as an archive. Comparison relocates it into the hearer's present, and admonition supplies the affective movement by which the analogy becomes conduct-guiding. Precedent therefore works as an active projection mechanism.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Instruction is delivered and made manifest by setting a prior case before present hearers as a visible, affective guide.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:34 joins descending signs, clarification, example, predecessors, and admonition.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Descent branches place material in a fitting rank, while the example branches operate both as a portable saying and as a perceptible sign from which a hearer crosses into warning.

parent_channels.name: [P3 24:35-46] Light Is Built as an Optical Engine

subchannels.name: Enclosure, Lamp, and Transparent Vessel
subchannels.scene_or_process: A recessed enclosure holds a lamp inside a transparent vessel whose concentrated clarity resembles a celestial body.
subchannels.active_motifs: non-through niche or lamp recess `quranic:root_000814:B005/m01`; lamp and lighting instrument `quranic:root_000839:B005/m01`; transparent glass vessel `quranic:root_000623:B004/m01`; star in the sky `quranic:root_001331:B001/m01`; pearl-like whiteness, clarity, and brilliance `quranic:root_000469:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:35 `كَمِشْكَاةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ الْمِصْبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍ الزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is an engineered concentration of output. The niche limits lateral loss, the lamp supplies emission, and the glass both contains and transmits it; stellar and pearl comparisons describe the resulting point of brilliance rather than replacing the apparatus.

subchannels.name: Biological Fuel Prepared Beyond Direction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A living tree produces oil whose stable abundance and placement outside a single east-west exposure prepare an unusually responsive fuel.
subchannels.active_motifs: extracted olive oil `quranic:root_000656:B001/m01`; olive tree and fruit `quranic:root_000656:B002/m01`; trunked tree `quranic:root_000777:B001/m01`; stable, increasing good `quranic:root_000109:B004/m01`; eastern emergence of light `quranic:root_000790:B001/m01`; western setting and direction `quranic:root_001077:B006/m01`; combustible material `quranic:root_001672:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:35 `مِن شَجَرَةٍ مُّبَارَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: Fuel is the outcome of a biological and spatial preparation process. The tree bears extractable energy, blessing marks stable increase, and the negated directional pair resists reducing the source to one-sided exposure. The light's reach begins before ignition.

subchannels.name: Near-Ignition and Layered Output
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fuel approaches luminosity before contact, ignition activates it, and the output accumulates as light upon light.
subchannels.active_motifs: sensory contact between bodies `quranic:root_001423:B001/m01`; ignition and burning `quranic:root_001672:B001/m01`; place where fire is kindled `quranic:root_001672:B003/m01`; shimmer resembling a kindled flame `quranic:root_001672:B006/m01`; iron-like incandescence `quranic:root_001331:B007/m01`; approach to an unrealized act `quranic:root_001329:B002/m01`; emitted radiance `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:35 `يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِيءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ نُّورٌ عَلَى نُورٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: The fuel is represented at the threshold of emission, fire supplies contact and activation, and several kinds of glow converge in the output. “Light upon light” is thus supported as cumulative amplification across prepared material, ignition, and transmission.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Radiance is produced through a fitted assembly of enclosure, transparent vessel, fuel, ignition, and directional independence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:35 explicitly stages niche, lamp, glass, star, blessed olive tree, oil, fire, layered light, east, and west.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The lexical branches distinguish optical housing from fuel biology and ignition physics, while pearl clarity and iron-like glow show radiance moving through several materials without becoming one undifferentiated “light” theme.

parent_channels.name: [P3 24:35-46] Worship Reorders Attention and Exchange

subchannels.name: Raised Houses Hold a Named Practice
subchannels.scene_or_process: An authorized dwelling is physically and socially elevated so voiced remembrance can occupy it.
subchannels.active_motifs: dwelling and shelter `quranic:root_000166:B001/m01`; house of rank and honor `quranic:root_000166:B008/m01`; physical raising `quranic:root_000582:B001/m01`; elevation of status `quranic:root_000582:B002/m01`; authorization `quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`; name as identifying declaration `quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`; mention carried on the tongue `quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:36 `فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ أَن تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ`
subchannels.synthesis: The house is both structure and status-bearing institution. Authorization permits elevation; elevation creates a durable setting; naming and voiced remembrance fill that setting with a repeated practice. The architecture serves attention rather than merely enclosing it.

subchannels.name: A Daily Rhythm of Praise
subchannels.scene_or_process: Worship recurs from early day to late afternoon, linking temporal endpoints through praise and formal prayer.
subchannels.active_motifs: early-morning departure or interval `quranic:root_001076:B001/m01`; late-afternoon interval `quranic:root_000038:B003/m01`; worship through praise `quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`; formal embodied prayer `quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`; bounded daytime period `quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:36 `يُسَبِّحُ ... بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِ`; 24:37 `إِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ ... يَوْمًا`
subchannels.synthesis: Morning and late day are not interchangeable labels but recurring gates that hold attention across a daily span. Praise occupies the interval, while formal prayer gives the rhythm a repeatable bodily form.

subchannels.name: Market Activity Fails to Capture Attention
subchannels.scene_or_process: Skilled profit-seeking and price exchange remain active but do not divert remembrance, prayer, or anticipatory fear.
subchannels.active_motifs: trade seeking profit `quranic:root_000176:B001/m01`; skill in methods of gain `quranic:root_000176:B004/m01`; exchange for a price `quranic:root_000169:B001/m01`; diversion by one activity from another `quranic:root_001382:B001/m01`; voiced remembrance `quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`; heart as cognitive-affective center `quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`; turning something from face to face `quranic:root_001248:B004/m01`; fear anticipating harm `quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:37 `لَا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَارَةٌ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَن ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ... يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ`
subchannels.synthesis: The text does not abolish commercial competence. It establishes a hierarchy of capture: trade may occupy action without commandeering the attention center. The anticipated turning of hearts makes future reversal an active counter-pressure on present distraction.

subchannels.name: Counter-Market Recompense
subchannels.scene_or_process: Deliberate work is evaluated, repaid, increased, and provisioned beyond the closed ledger of ordinary exchange.
subchannels.active_motifs: recompense corresponding to an act `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; collection and full settlement of a debt `quranic:root_000244:B003/m01`; counting and account `quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`; apportioned provision `quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`; unowed gift `quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`; growth beyond the prior amount `quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`; beautiful and excellent action `quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:38 `لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ وَاللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ ... بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: Recompense begins with correspondence to work but does not end there. Debt-settlement and counting establish the recognizable exchange frame; increase, gift, and provision exceed it. The result is a counter-market whose output is not exhausted by equivalence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A raised place and repeated daily rhythm stabilize attention against market capture, after which recompense arrives through a value system not bounded by ordinary accounting.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct and indirect; 24:36-38 links elevated houses, named remembrance, morning/evening praise, trade, sale, prayer, heart-turning fear, reward, increase, provision, and account.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Architecture, schedule, cognition, commerce, debt collection, and unmeasured provision form distinct mechanisms within one attention economy.

parent_channels.name: [P3 24:35-46] Visibility Fails by Substitution or Burial

subchannels.name: Mirage Substitutes for Water
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thirsty observer on an open plain takes a shimmering surface for water because visual resemblance meets urgent desire.
subchannels.active_motifs: mirage appearing as water `quranic:root_000691:B009/m01`; flat open ground `quranic:root_001270:B001/m01`; bodily thirst `quranic:root_000968:B001/m01`; longing for encounter figured as thirst `quranic:root_000968:B003/m01`; actual water `quranic:root_001458:B001/m01`; crystalline or mirror-like water clarity `quranic:root_001458:B007/m01`; supposition formed in the mind `quranic:root_000318:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:39 `كَسَرَابٍ بِقِيعَةٍ يَحْسَبُهُ الظَّمْآنُ مَاءً`
subchannels.synthesis: Misperception is jointly produced by surface and observer. The plain supplies shimmer, water-like clarity supplies resemblance, thirst supplies the projected completion, and supposition closes the gap. The false object is visually present but materially absent.

subchannels.name: Arrival Converts Search into Account
subchannels.scene_or_process: The seeker reaches the expected site, fails to retrieve the projected object, encounters the actual authority there, and receives a fully settled account.
subchannels.active_motifs: coming to a place or outcome `quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`; finding or failing to find an object `quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`; water as sought object `quranic:root_001458:B001/m01`; complete settlement without remainder `quranic:root_001669:B001/m01`; counting and reckoning `quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`; speed opposed to delay `quranic:root_000698:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:39 `حَتَّى إِذَا جَاءَهُ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْئًا وَوَجَدَ اللَّهَ عِندَهُ فَوَفَّاهُ حِسَابَهُ وَاللَّهُ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ`
subchannels.synthesis: The mirage scene ends as a retrieval and settlement scene. Arrival cancels the imagined object, but not encounter itself; the empty visual promise is replaced by exact, immediate accounting. Failure to find is therefore a transition into being found and measured.

subchannels.name: Layered Sea Occlusion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A deep body of water, one wave above another, cloud, and covering stack vertically until light cannot traverse the column.
subchannels.active_motifs: wide abundant sea `quranic:root_000086:B001/m01`; deep turbulent main body of the sea `quranic:root_001344:B002/m01`; black intermingled darkness `quranic:root_001344:B007/m01`; rising interpenetrating wave `quranic:root_001455:B001/m01`; vertical superposition `quranic:root_001188:B001/m01`; dragged cloud mass `quranic:root_000680:B002/m01`; covering laid over an object `quranic:root_001088:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:40 `فِي بَحْرٍ لُّجِّيٍّ يَغْشَاهُ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِ سَحَابٌ ... بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: Unlike the mirage, nothing here falsely occupies the target's place. Visibility is lost by accumulated path length and covering: depth, turbulence, repeated vertical layers, and cloud each remove transmissibility. The scene models ignorance as burial rather than substitution.

subchannels.name: The Near Hand Still Cannot Be Seen
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hand is extended from the obscured interior toward the observer's own visual field, yet recognition remains only approached and never completed.
subchannels.active_motifs: hand as bodily extremity `quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`; emergence from an interior `quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`; ocular recognition `quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`; act approached but unrealized `quranic:root_001329:B002/m01`; refusal or failure under negation `quranic:root_001329:B003/m01`; emitted light `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:40 `إِذَا أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَاهَا ... فَمَا لَهُ مِن نُّورٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: Distance is reduced to the nearest practical object, but the optical channel remains closed. The paired “almost” and negated failure senses hold perception at a threshold it cannot cross, making absent light a functional incapacity rather than only a dark setting.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Perception fails either because a false object occupies the desired object's visual place or because successive coverings absorb the path between observer and object.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:39-40 contrasts mirage-water misrecognition with layered sea, waves, cloud, darkness, an extended hand, failed sight, and absent light.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The branches separate optical resemblance, motivated projection, failed retrieval, exact accounting, vertical occlusion, and near-but-blocked recognition.

parent_channels.name: [P3 24:35-46] Clouds Operate as an Assembly Line

subchannels.name: Draw, Join, and Stack
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate cloud material is gently driven, drawn into relation, joined, and piled layer upon layer.
subchannels.active_motifs: gentle driving until an object moves `quranic:root_000625:B001/m01`; dragging and extending material `quranic:root_000680:B001/m01`; mobile cloud mass `quranic:root_000680:B002/m01`; joining separate parts `quranic:root_000045:B002/m01`; stacking one thing on another into a heap `quranic:root_000595:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:43 `يُزْجِي سَحَابًا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ رُكَامًا`
subchannels.synthesis: Cloud formation is decomposed into transport, relation, joining, and vertical accumulation. The sequence resembles an assembly process in which dispersed components become a single load capable of producing output.

subchannels.name: Precipitation Through Openings
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water and ice emerge from the stacked mass through internal gaps and descend from elevated, mountain-like concentrations.
subchannels.active_motifs: gap or passage between things `quranic:root_000435:B001/m01`; rain issuing from cloud gaps `quranic:root_001636:B003/m01`; emergence from an enclosure `quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`; downward rain settling below `quranic:root_000889:B001/m01`; cold and hail `quranic:root_000103:B001/m01`; elevated solid mass `quranic:root_000217:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:43 `فَتَرَى الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَالِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِن جِبَالٍ فِيهَا مِن بَرَدٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: The heap does not release uniformly. Internal apertures become outlets, and elevated concentrations function like mountains storing and releasing frozen material. The scene preserves distinct liquid, solid, channel, and descent roles.

subchannels.name: Lightning Captures and Is Diverted
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sudden flash approaches the threshold of seizing vision while impact and diversion remain selectively directed.
subchannels.active_motifs: cloud lightning and reflected flash `quranic:root_000108:B001/m01`; eye transfixed by shock `quranic:root_000108:B002/m01`; lightning's intense radiance `quranic:root_000751:B004/m01`; action on the verge of occurring `quranic:root_001329:B002/m01`; taking something away in motion `quranic:root_000522:B006/m01`; ocular seeing `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; turning an effect away from its course `quranic:root_000860:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:43 `فَيُصِيبُ بِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُ عَن مَّن يَشَاءُ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِ يَذْهَبُ بِالْأَبْصَارِ`
subchannels.synthesis: Lightning is not merely visible; it acts on the organ of vision and nearly removes its capacity. The adjacent impact/diversion sequence gives weather directed force: discharge can reach one path and be turned from another.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Weather is produced through ordered transport, joining, stacking, channelled release, and selective optical force.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:43 narrates cloud driving, joining, heaping, rain emerging through gaps, hail descending from mountain-like masses, selective impact/diversion, and lightning taking sight.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Gentle herding, component assembly, layered stockpiling, outlet geometry, and redirected discharge make the cloud a process mechanism rather than a static sign.

parent_channels.name: [P3 24:35-46] Creation Is Measured into Distinct Gaits

subchannels.name: Common Material, Differentiated Form
subchannels.scene_or_process: A shared watery material is measured, brought into being, proportioned, and prepared for divergent bodily outcomes.
subchannels.active_motifs: prior measuring and cutting plan `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; bringing a creature into being `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; completed and proportioned form `quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`; water as material `quranic:root_001458:B001/m02`; bounded amount or capacity `quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`; reflective planning and fitting `quranic:root_001205:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:45 `وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِن مَّاءٍ ... يَخْلُقُ اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاءُ ... قَدِيرٌ`
subchannels.synthesis: Unity lies in material source, not final shape. Measuring and planning mediate the transition from water to proportioned bodies, allowing one origin to produce several support systems without erasing their differences.

subchannels.name: Belly-Contact Movement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A creature advances through low, subtle motion with its underside in sustained relation to the ground.
subchannels.active_motifs: slow or light creeping on earth `quranic:root_000457:B001/m01`; hidden diffusion too subtle for sense `quranic:root_000457:B003/m01`; belly and underside `quranic:root_000128:B001/m01`; voluntary locomotion `quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:45 `فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَى بَطْنِهِ`
subchannels.synthesis: The belly is not an incidental body part but the movement interface. Creeping and hidden diffusion describe low-amplitude transit, while voluntary motion keeps the creature an agent rather than a passively sliding object.

subchannels.name: Bipedal Walking
subchannels.scene_or_process: Alternating leg supports raise the body into ordinary walking without requiring an external mount.
subchannels.active_motifs: leg as bodily support `quranic:root_000546:B001/m01`; walking on one's own legs `quranic:root_000546:B003/m01`; voluntary locomotion `quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:45 `وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَى رِجْلَيْنِ`
subchannels.synthesis: The two-legged class is a support-and-transfer mechanism: the named limbs bear and advance the body. Its economy contrasts both full belly contact and fourfold support.

subchannels.name: Fourfold Support and Drive
subchannels.scene_or_process: Four supports distribute force like a four-ply construction and can intensify into the driving gait of a quadruped.
subchannels.active_motifs: numerical four `quranic:root_000536:B001/m01`; object formed on four strands or powers `quranic:root_000536:B003/m01`; forceful camel run through its limbs `quranic:root_000536:B012/m01`; leg as support `quranic:root_000546:B001/m01`; voluntary locomotion `quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:45 `وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَى أَرْبَعٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: The numerical branch becomes structural: four points can distribute and twist force into a stable whole. The camel-running sense then carries that geometry into propulsion, materializing the quadruped as a coordinated force system.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A common material origin is measured into different bodily forms, and each form realizes motion through its own support geometry.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:45 moves from creation out of water to belly movement, two-legged walking, fourfold support, and unconstrained divine choice and power.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Planning, proportion, hidden creeping, four-ply construction, and camel sprint branches expose locomotion as designed mechanics rather than a flat list of animal types.

parent_channels.name: [P3 24:35-46] Creatures Embody Their Own Worship Pattern

subchannels.name: Birds Hold a Linear Formation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flying creatures spread through the air and maintain a level row as an embodied configuration of praise.
subchannels.active_motifs: bird and aerial lightness `quranic:root_000962:B001/m01`; spreading outward after light movement `quranic:root_000962:B002/m01`; alignment on a straight row `quranic:root_000871:B001/m01`; worship through praise `quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:41 `وَالطَّيْرُ صَافَّاتٍ ... وَتَسْبِيحَهُ`
subchannels.synthesis: The row is not merely background to praise. The birds' aerial capacity and straight formation supply its bodily grammar, so arrangement itself participates in the act.

subchannels.name: Known Prayer Becomes Action
subchannels.scene_or_process: Each creature recognizes its proper ritual pattern and realizes that knowledge in a creature-specific act.
