subchannels.active_motifs: knowledge as disclosed recognition `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; formal prayer `quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`; praise and devotional act `quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`; bringing an action into occurrence `quranic:root_001167:B001/m01`; each whole unit `quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:41 `كُلٌّ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُ وَتَسْبِيحَهُ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ`
subchannels.synthesis: Knowledge here has a performative endpoint. Each whole creature bears a differentiated pattern, recognizes it, and acts it out under encompassing knowledge. The channel preserves plurality of forms within unity of orientation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Creature-specific bodily arrangement and creature-specific knowledge converge in an enacted form of praise.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:41 identifies birds in rows and says each knows its prayer and praise.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Flight, linear formation, ritual act, and known action make worship a species-shaped performance rather than a disembodied generic utterance.

parent_channels.name: [P3 24:35-46] Guidance Makes Perception Traversable

subchannels.name: Light Becomes a Landmark
subchannels.scene_or_process: Radiance is raised into a visible marker that identifies a route and gently directs a traveler toward it.
subchannels.active_motifs: beacon or tower used for finding a route `quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`; distinguishing mark or road boundary `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`; visible sign `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`; gentle direction toward route or truth `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`; manifest disclosure `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:35 `نُورٌ ... يَهْدِي اللَّهُ لِنُورِهِ`; 24:46 `آيَاتٍ مُّبَيِّنَاتٍ وَاللَّهُ يَهْدِي`
subchannels.synthesis: Light becomes guidance when it is positioned and read as a marker. Visibility, distinction, and direction cooperate: the sign must stand out, identify a course, and move the perceiver toward it.

subchannels.name: The Straight Route as an Unimpeded Line
subchannels.scene_or_process: Direction is stabilized into an even road whose latent cutting force suggests a line that passes cleanly through obstruction.
subchannels.active_motifs: straight road `quranic:root_000858:B001/m01`; cutting and penetrating blade `quranic:root_000858:B003/m01`; straightness and even alignment `quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`; direction, manner, and intended heading `quranic:root_001583:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:46 `يَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: Straightness describes more than shape. The route has a stable heading and an even relation among its parts; the blade sense usefully pressures the image toward clean passage, while remaining a lexical resonance rather than the surface object.

subchannels.name: Alternation Trains Insight
subchannels.scene_or_process: Night and day are repeatedly turned over; an observer crosses from seeing the cycle to drawing a guiding analogy from it.
subchannels.active_motifs: turning an object from face to face `quranic:root_001248:B004/m01`; night and its darkness `quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`; day opening in light `quranic:root_001559:B002/m01`; crossing from one side to another `quranic:root_000974:B001/m01`; inferential lesson drawn from one state to another `quranic:root_000974:B004/m01`; ocular perception `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:44 `يُقَلِّبُ اللَّهُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّأُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ`
subchannels.synthesis: Environmental reversal becomes guidance only when perception crosses into analogy. The observer sees alternating illumination, then uses one state to interpret another. The cycle is therefore both object and instrument of insight.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Guidance converts radiance into markers, aligns a traversable route, and trains vision through repeated environmental reversals.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct and indirect; 24:35 connects light and guidance, 24:44 turns night/day alternation into a lesson for sight, and 24:46 joins manifest signs to a straight path.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Beacon, boundary marker, cutting line, crosswise passage, and analogical lesson branches show guidance as perceptual infrastructure rather than only conveyed information.

parent_channels.name: [P4 24:47-64] Judgment Exposes Direction

subchannels.name: Profession Reverses into Withdrawal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A group voices a creed and obedience, then a separated portion turns its face away from the direction it named.
subchannels.active_motifs: spoken utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; statement as held creed `quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`; heart-settling assent `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`; compliance with an instruction `quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`; turning the face toward a thing `quranic:root_001684:B006/m01`; turning away and abandoning compliance `quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`; separated group or stray portion `quranic:root_001148:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:47 `يَقُولُونَ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَبِالرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّى فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene measures orientation by motion after speech. Profession points one way, but a separated portion physically and socially reverses. The flock-like sense of `فريق` sharpens how withdrawal breaks a unit away from its declared course.

subchannels.name: The Adjudicative Summons
subchannels.scene_or_process: Disputants are called toward an authorized judge; the process distinguishes stable right from selective compliance.
subchannels.active_motifs: vocal summons drawing another near `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`; messenger and carried message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; adjudication between parties `quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`; delegating judgment to an arbiter `quranic:root_000348:B005/m01`; reality fixed against falsehood `quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`; right specifically held by a claimant `quranic:root_000347:B003/m01`; quick submissive approach `quranic:root_000514:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:48 `دُعُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ`; 24:49 `وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ الْحَقُّ يَأْتُوا إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ`
subchannels.synthesis: Calling, delegated judgment, and claimant right form a court scene. The diagnostic feature is asymmetry: parties approach quickly when the right appears to belong to them but resist the same forum otherwise. Submission to judgment is tested independently of expected outcome.

subchannels.name: Inner Obstruction as Disease, Doubt, or Expected Bias
subchannels.scene_or_process: The heart's refusal is examined as impaired condition, unstable uncertainty, or fear that judgment will incline away from fairness.
subchannels.active_motifs: heart as cognitive-affective organ `quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`; departure from bodily health and balance `quranic:root_001415:B001/m01`; dimming and loss of clarity `quranic:root_001415:B005/m01`; agitated doubt `quranic:root_000616:B001/m01`; anticipated harm `quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`; slope or partiality in judgment `quranic:root_000380:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:50 `أَفِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ارْتَابُوا أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُ`
subchannels.synthesis: The three questions isolate different failure modes. Disease names impaired balance, doubt names epistemic vibration, and fear of `حيف` projects a tilted court. The optical-dimming branch shows how an unhealthy interior can reduce its own capacity to perceive fairness.

subchannels.name: Hearing Completes Itself in Action
subchannels.scene_or_process: A summons reaches the ear, is understood and accepted, becomes obedience, and terminates in safety and attained good.
subchannels.active_motifs: auditory reception `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`; hearing as comprehension and compliance `quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`; obedience `quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`; success and continuing good `quranic:root_001175:B005/m01`; deliverance and attainment `quranic:root_001186:B001/m01`; reverent fear `quranic:root_000413:B001/m01`; placing oneself behind a protection `quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Hearing is complete only when reception passes through understanding into action. Obedience, protective caution, and reverent fear then produce two distinct outcomes: enduring flourishing and escape-with-attainment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A summons to judgment reveals whether professed orientation becomes embodied approach or reverses into withdrawal, doubt, and fear of bias.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:47-52 contrasts voiced belief and obedience with turning away, adjudicative summons, selective submission, diseased hearts, doubt, feared partiality, hearing, obedience, and success.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Face-turning, separated flock, judicial slope, bodily disease, optical dimming, and understood hearing make response to judgment a directional and diagnostic event.

parent_channels.name: [P4 24:47-64] Enacted Obedience Outweighs Maximal Oath

subchannels.name: The Oath Stack Amplifies Assertion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speakers bind a divine-name oath, intensify it with their utmost effort, and promise immediate execution if commanded.
subchannels.active_motifs: sworn division of liability `quranic:root_001226:B004/m01`; oath made by the right hand `quranic:root_001698:B003/m01`; divine name in oath `quranic:root_000047:B002/m01`; exerting full capacity under strain `quranic:root_000268:B001/m01`; binding command `quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`; speech brought into utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:53 `وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِنْ أَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّ`
subchannels.synthesis: Each lexical component raises verbal force: sacred name, formal oath, bodily side, maximum effort, and promised response. The stack is impressive precisely so the counter-demand can reject assertion as the governing evidence.

subchannels.name: Recognizable Conduct Supplies Proof
subchannels.scene_or_process: Compliance takes a socially recognizable form, becomes deliberate work, and is known through the interior reality of the action rather than its verbal display.
subchannels.active_motifs: obedience as enacted compliance `quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`; recognized good approved by reason and norm `quranic:root_001002:B005/m01`; identifying something by its trace `quranic:root_001002:B003/m01`; deliberate action `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`; expertise in an affair's hidden reality `quranic:root_000387:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:53 `لَا تُقْسِمُوا طَاعَةٌ مَّعْرُوفَةٌ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ`
subchannels.synthesis: Known obedience is visible by its trace and norm-governed form. Deliberate work supplies the evidence that speech sought to provide, while expertise reaches the action's inward quality. The scene replaces oath volume with performative recognizability.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Verbal intensity cannot substitute for ordinary, recognizable compliance whose reality is disclosed by conduct.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:53 contrasts strenuous oaths with `طَاعَةٌ مَّعْرُوفَةٌ` and divine knowledge of action.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Oath, exertion, command, recognized good, inward expertise, and deliberate work form two rival proof systems: amplified assertion and observable performance.

parent_channels.name: [P4 24:47-64] Promise Installs a Successive Order

subchannels.name: Successors Are Placed and Enabled
subchannels.scene_or_process: A spoken commitment opens a future horizon in which one group follows another, occupies its station, and gains effective capacity.
subchannels.active_motifs: promise that opens expectation `quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`; promise fixed to a future point `quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`; hopeful sign of an approaching state `quranic:root_001662:B006/m01`; successor replacing what preceded `quranic:root_000433:B001/m01`; alternating arrival of one group after another `quranic:root_000433:B006/m01`; place that contains an entity `quranic:root_001439:B003/m01`; effective enablement and power `quranic:root_001439:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:55 `وَعَدَ اللَّهُ ... لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ كَمَا اسْتَخْلَفَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ`
subchannels.synthesis: Promise is implemented through succession, station, and capacity. A later community enters an earlier one's place, but emplacement alone is insufficient; enablement gives the new order operative force. The sequence makes historical continuity an installed relation.

subchannels.name: Fear Is Replaced by Security
subchannels.scene_or_process: An unstable state of anticipated harm is removed, another state occupies its place, and the interior settles into trust.
subchannels.active_motifs: one thing taking another's place `quranic:root_000095:B001/m01`; transformation of condition `quranic:root_000095:B002/m01`; fear anticipating harm `quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`; settled safety and trust `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:55 `وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّن بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا`
subchannels.synthesis: Security is not simply added to fear; replacement changes the governing state. The substitution branch and the transformation branch distinguish who or what occupies the position from how the position's quality is altered.

subchannels.name: Worship Holds Without a Dividing Partner
subchannels.scene_or_process: The installed order directs obedience toward one object of worship and excludes any co-holder from that relation.
subchannels.active_motifs: worship through submissive obedience `quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`; deity as object of worship `quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`; associating a partner with God `quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`; religion as obedience and submission `quranic:root_000504:B001/m01`; covering or denying truth `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:55 `يَعْبُدُونَنِي لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِي شَيْئًا وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ`
subchannels.synthesis: Political succession and security reach their intended stability in an undivided obedience relation. Partnering would split that orientation; denial would cover the transformation after it has become manifest. Worship therefore anchors the order's internal coherence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Promise becomes historical reality by placing successors, enabling a durable order, transforming fear into security, and stabilizing undivided worship.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct and indirect; 24:55 joins promise, succession, emplacement, established religion, replacement of fear by safety, worship, and refusal of partners.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Substitution, alternating sequence, installed capacity, and state transformation render promise as institutional construction rather than remote prediction.

parent_channels.name: [P4 24:47-64] The Messenger Is a Bounded Carrier

subchannels.name: Payload, Burden, and Delivery Limit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bearer receives a specified message-load, carries it to its audience, makes it clear, and is not assigned the audience's response-load.
subchannels.active_motifs: messenger and carried statement `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; bringing a message to its terminus `quranic:root_000151:B002/m01`; entrusted message or liability borne as a load `quranic:root_000357:B003/m01`; meaning disclosed in clear expression `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`; gentle direction toward the right course `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:54 `عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُم مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ ... تَهْتَدُوا ... وَمَا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene has explicit load boundaries. The messenger bears and delivers a communicative payload; the audience bears response. Clarity belongs to delivery, while guidance becomes available through obedience rather than by transferring audience liability back to the carrier.

subchannels.name: Disciplined Transmission Motion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dispatch releases a carrier into a smooth, unhurried course, and transmission can proceed in successive groups without losing continuity.
subchannels.active_motifs: sending and releasing `quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`; smooth, easy movement `quranic:root_000563:B003/m01`; deliberate pacing and composure `quranic:root_000563:B004/m01`; successive bands following one another `quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: These senses describe how transmission travels rather than what it says. Release initiates motion; smoothness and deliberation govern tempo; successive bands preserve relay across plurality. The channel supports clear conveyance as controlled propagation, not uncontrolled rumor.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Transmission has both a limited payload and a disciplined motion: a message is carried to its boundary through clear, measured delivery.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct and indirect; 24:54 distinguishes the messenger's burden, the hearers' burden, obedience, guidance, and clear conveyance.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Dispatch, smooth gait, deliberate pacing, and successive bands separate the carrier's movement from the content and liability carried.

parent_channels.name: [P4 24:47-64] Privacy Changes with Clock and Life Stage

subchannels.name: Three Timed Privacy Gates
subchannels.scene_or_process: Permission closes routine access at three scheduled moments marked by prayer, undressing, dawn, and midday.
subchannels.active_motifs: permission controlled by an admitting authority `quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`; number three `quranic:root_000203:B001/m01`; assigning a known time to an act `quranic:root_000382:B003/m01`; dawn breaking from night `quranic:root_001132:B002/m01`; midday interval `quranic:root_000970:B004/m01`; formal prayer `quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`; garment and clothing `quranic:root_000209:B003/m01`; private exposure or secluded interval `quranic:root_001060:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:58 `لِيَسْتَأْذِنكُم ... ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ مِن قَبْلِ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ الظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِن بَعْدِ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ ثَلَاثُ عَوْرَاتٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: Privacy is a scheduled gate, not an undifferentiated prohibition. The count fixes recurrence; dawn, midday undressing, and post-night prayer define distinct conditions under which ordinary access must pause.

subchannels.name: Routine Circulation Reopens Access
subchannels.scene_or_process: Outside the gated intervals, household dependents circulate repeatedly among members, making movement itself an expected service pattern.
subchannels.active_motifs: owned dependent status `quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`; attendants repeatedly circling those served `quranic:root_000957:B001/m01`; encircling group or portion `quranic:root_000957:B004/m01`; interdependent parts of one social body `quranic:root_000133:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:58 `طَوَّافُونَ عَلَيْكُم بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ`
subchannels.synthesis: The exception is explained by traffic pattern. Recurrent service requires ordinary permeability, so privacy closes only at marked intervals rather than defeating household circulation altogether.

subchannels.name: Puberty Changes the Permission Rule
subchannels.scene_or_process: A child reaches a biological-social threshold and moves from limited timed permission to the general adult access protocol.
subchannels.active_motifs: reaching an appointed limit or maturity `quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`; attainment of puberty `quranic:root_000352:B003/m01`; child at an early life stage `quranic:root_000942:B001/m01`; prior adult precedent `quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`; permission `quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:58 `الَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا الْحُلُمَ`; 24:59 `وَإِذَا بَلَغَ الْأَطْفَالُ مِنكُمُ الْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَأْذِنُوا كَمَا اسْتَأْذَنَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ`
subchannels.synthesis: Age classification changes through a threshold event. Before it, permission is time-limited; after it, the child enters the precedent followed by earlier adults. The access rule tracks attained capacity rather than chronological label alone.

subchannels.name: Elder Garment Relaxation Retains a Display Boundary
subchannels.scene_or_process: Women beyond expected marriage may lay aside an outer covering without converting that relaxation into intentional adornment-display, while restraint remains preferable.
subchannels.active_motifs: woman beyond menstruation, childbearing, or marriage `quranic:root_001244:B003/m01`; women as a social class `quranic:root_001500:B001/m01`; marital contract or expectation `quranic:root_001548:B002/m01`; an older woman laying aside her veil `quranic:root_001657:B009/m01`; garment `quranic:root_000209:B003/m01`; adornment as a worn object `quranic:root_000660:B003/m01`; deliberate self-display `quranic:root_000101:B003/m01`; restraint from sexual impropriety `quranic:root_001031:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:60 `وَالْقَوَاعِدُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ اللَّاتِي لَا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحًا ... أَن يَضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجَاتٍ بِزِينَةٍ وَأَن يَسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌ`
subchannels.synthesis: The rule changes because life stage alters the social scene, but two garment operations remain distinct: laying aside and displaying. Relaxation permits the first without licensing the second, and restraint preserves a voluntarily stronger boundary.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Domestic exposure is regulated by thresholds that shift with daily rhythm, routine circulation, puberty, and the end of expected marriage.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:58-60 defines three private times, circulating dependents, puberty-based permission, elderly women, garment relaxation, display, and continued restraint.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Time-gating, traffic flow, biological transition, and garment operation produce a dynamic access system rather than one static modesty rule.

parent_channels.name: [P4 24:47-64] Hospitality Defines a Distributed Household

subchannels.name: Disability Removes Constriction, Not Membership
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodily difference and illness are named, then legal and social constriction is lifted so eating remains available.
subchannels.active_motifs: loss of sight `quranic:root_001049:B001/m01`; lameness of gait `quranic:root_000997:B001/m01`; bodily departure from health `quranic:root_001415:B001/m01`; severe constriction `quranic:root_000304:B002/m01`; fear of guilt or sin `quranic:root_000304:B003/m01`; one's own embodied self `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:61 `لَيْسَ عَلَى الْأَعْمَى حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى أَنفُسِكُمْ`
subchannels.synthesis: The verse removes both practical narrowness and moral anxiety. Bodily conditions remain differentiated, but none becomes a reason to constrict participation. The self-anchor then places those named bodies inside the same permission frame as everyone else.

subchannels.name: Vertical and Sibling Houses
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dwelling and household membership extend eating access through parents, siblings, and the lines they establish.
subchannels.active_motifs: dwelling as shelter `quranic:root_000166:B001/m01`; household members `quranic:root_000166:B002/m01`; fatherhood and nurture `quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`; motherhood and nurture `quranic:root_000053:B001/m01`; sibling kinship `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:61 `بُيُوتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ آبَائِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ إِخْوَانِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَاتِكُمْ`
subchannels.synthesis: The “house” alternates between structure and persons organized by it. Parent and sibling relations create overlapping interiors, so eating access follows a lineage graph rather than stopping at the walls of one's own dwelling.

subchannels.name: Lateral Kin, Friendship, and the Key
subchannels.scene_or_process: Paternal and maternal side-relations, trusted friendship, and delegated control of an opening extend access beyond the immediate household.
subchannels.active_motifs: paternal uncle or aunt relation `quranic:root_001047:B001/m01`; maternal uncle or aunt relation `quranic:root_000448:B004/m01`; friendship grounded in truthful attachment `quranic:root_000852:B005/m01`; key as instrument reaching what is closed `quranic:root_001124:B006/m01`; ownership and delegated disposal `quranic:root_001444:B002/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:61 `بُيُوتِ أَعْمَامِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخْوَالِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ خَالَاتِكُمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ`
subchannels.synthesis: Access expands laterally through kin and trust, then becomes operational through a key. The key is not the relation itself; it is the tool by which delegated authority opens a closed resource. Friendship appears alongside kin because truthful attachment can sustain comparable trust.

subchannels.name: Joint or Separate Eating
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food may be consumed around a common locus or by spatially separated participants without changing the permission to eat.
subchannels.active_motifs: taking food `quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`; eating vessel or place `quranic:root_000043:B013/m01`; joining dispersed persons `quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`; scattering into separate groups `quranic:root_000775:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:61 `أَن تَأْكُلُوا جَمِيعًا أَوْ أَشْتَاتًا`
subchannels.synthesis: Gathering and scattering describe configurations, not grades of legitimacy. A shared vessel can gather bodies into one scene, but permission persists when they disperse. Social inclusion is therefore not made dependent on a single seating form.

subchannels.name: Greeting Makes Entry Safe and Wholesome
subchannels.scene_or_process: On crossing a household threshold, entrants address the social self with a greeting that restores safety and carries stable good.
subchannels.active_motifs: entry into an interior `quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`; safety and freedom from defect `quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`; the self as the same social body `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`; greeting that invokes life and peace `quranic:root_000383:B007/m01`; stable increasing good `quranic:root_000109:B004/m01`; wholesomeness opposed to corruption `quranic:root_000961:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:61 `فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُم بُيُوتًا فَسَلِّمُوا عَلَى أَنفُسِكُمْ تَحِيَّةً مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ مُبَارَكَةً طَيِّبَةً`
subchannels.synthesis: Entry changes physical location; greeting repairs the social boundary crossed. Addressing others as `أنفسكم` identifies host and entrant as parts of one body, while safety, blessing, and wholesomeness specify the state the greeting is meant to create.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Eating rights extend the household across bodily ability, kinship, keys, friendship, group configuration, and greeting at entry.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 24:61 removes constriction, enumerates houses and relations, permits joint or separate eating, and prescribes a blessed wholesome greeting on entry.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The branches turn the long list into a social topology: vertical and lateral kin lines, delegated access by key, shared vessel, scattered seating, and greeting as restoration of safety.

parent_channels.name: [P4 24:47-64] Collective Work Requires Visible Permission

subchannels.name: A Gathered Affair and an Authorized Exception
subchannels.scene_or_process: Participants collect around a resolved common matter; one person's separate concern can be accommodated through explicit permission.
subchannels.active_motifs: resolution that gathers scattered judgment `quranic:root_000259:B003/m01`; place or call that gathers people `quranic:root_000259:B004/m01`; significant common affair `quranic:root_000773:B001/m01`; individual purpose sought `quranic:root_000773:B002/m01`; affair or matter as the shared object `quranic:root_000051:B001/m01`; authorization to leave `quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:62 `عَلَى أَمْرٍ جَامِعٍ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوا حَتَّى يَسْتَأْذِنُوهُ ... لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ`
subchannels.synthesis: The group is held together by more than co-presence: dispersed judgments have been collected into an undertaking. Permission makes a personal exception visible and bounded, allowing the common affair to remain coherent while acknowledging a distinct concern.

subchannels.name: Stealth Exit as Extraction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant draws himself out of the assembly gradually and hides the movement behind another person's body.
subchannels.active_motifs: drawing an object out gently and invisibly `quranic:root_000736:B001/m01`; secret removal resembling theft `quranic:root_000736:B002/m01`; slipping out through a crowd `quranic:root_000736:B004/m01`; taking refuge behind another `quranic:root_001385:B001/m01`; mutual concealment and one-by-one withdrawal `quranic:root_001385:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:63 `الَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمْ لِوَاذًا`
subchannels.synthesis: Unauthorized absence is rendered as an extraction process, not a simple change of location. Gradual motion reduces visibility, crowd density provides cover, and another body becomes a shield. The mechanism is the negative image of explicit permission.

subchannels.name: Opposition Triggers Trial or Painful Impact
subchannels.scene_or_process: Divergence from the governing command exposes the dissenter to testing that may arrive as social disruption or bodily pain.
subchannels.active_motifs: taking a route contrary to another's `quranic:root_000433:B004/m01`; vigilant avoidance of danger `quranic:root_000301:B001/m01`; assay that separates sound from unsound `quranic:root_001128:B001/m01`; ordeal and affliction `quranic:root_001128:B004/m01`; calamity striking a person `quranic:root_000889:B004/m01`; inflicted pain `quranic:root_000046:B002/m01`; punishment as severe hurt `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:63 `فَلْيَحْذَرِ الَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِ أَن تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ أَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ`
subchannels.synthesis: Opposition is directional divergence, and warning asks the dissenter to recognize the exposed path that follows. Trial tests composition; calamity and painful punishment describe possible outcomes. The branches keep diagnostic testing distinct from inflicted consequence.

subchannels.name: The Messenger's Call Is Not an Ordinary Summons
subchannels.scene_or_process: A call carried by the messenger establishes a relation unlike reciprocal peer-calling and therefore cannot be treated as casual background sound.
subchannels.active_motifs: summons by voice `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`; messenger and message-bearing role `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; parts or persons set in reciprocal relation `quranic:root_000133:B001/m01`; disclosed knowledge of hidden conduct `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:63 `لَا تَجْعَلُوا دُعَاءَ الرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَاءِ بَعْضِكُم بَعْضًا قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ`
subchannels.synthesis: Peer calls circulate laterally among comparable parts; the messenger's call carries an assigned office and payload. Treating the two alike erases the relation that makes collective authorization binding, even if stealth temporarily hides the response from other participants.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A common undertaking remains coherent when gathering, attendance, personal departure, and warning are handled through explicit authorization rather than hidden extraction.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct and indirect; 24:62-63 joins a gathering affair, permission for personal concerns, the messenger's call, stealth exit behind others, opposition to command, trial, and painful impact.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Resolve gathered from scattered opinion, assembly space, sword-like extraction, concealment behind another body, and metallurgical testing make attendance a problem of visible cohesion.

parent_channels.name: [P4 24:47-64] No Path Leaves the Owner's Reach

subchannels.name: Local Control Sits Inside Encompassing Possession
subchannels.scene_or_process: Human ownership and delegated control are nested inside sovereignty that encompasses the upper and lower world and knows every state within it.
subchannels.active_motifs: political and divine sovereignty `quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`; owned property and delegated disposal `quranic:root_001444:B002/m02`; sky and all that rises overhead `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; earth as the lower field `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; complete inclusion of parts `quranic:root_001315:B003/m02`; knowledge that uncovers its object `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:58 `مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ`; 24:61 `مَا مَلَكْتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُ`; 24:64 `لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ... وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ`
subchannels.synthesis: Human control is real but nested. The same ownership root that marks dependents and keys opens onto sovereignty, while sky, earth, totality, and knowledge close the containing frame. No local possessor controls an outside.

subchannels.name: Return Ends in Report
subchannels.scene_or_process: Agents are sent back to the originating authority, their deliberate acts are converted into report, and their actual condition becomes fully known.
subchannels.active_motifs: return to an original source `quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`; reported news carrying consequential knowledge `quranic:root_001464:B002/m01`; deliberate deed `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`; bounded day of occurrence `quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`; knowledge as complete disclosure `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:64 `وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ`
subchannels.synthesis: Return is not spatial closure alone. Action is translated into informative report, and the subject hears the disclosed meaning of what was done. The process joins trajectory, event-time, deed, and knowledge in one endpoint.

subchannels.name: Failed Escape Finds Fire as Refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fugitives try to outrun reach across open earth, fail to produce an outside, and arrive at a shelter that is itself burning destination.
subchannels.active_motifs: incapacity to accomplish an act `quranic:root_000985:B001/m01`; escaping or outrunning pursuit `quranic:root_000985:B002/m01`; lower open earth `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; joining a place that receives and shelters `quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`; burning fire `quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`; endpoint and final outcome `quranic:root_000897:B001/m01`; desert poised between deliverance and destruction `quranic:root_001186:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 24:52 `الْفَائِزُونَ`; 24:57 `لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ وَلَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ`
subchannels.synthesis: The escape scene inverts the success sense active at 24:52. Open terrain appears to offer outrunning, but no external refuge exists; the receiving shelter is fire, and the traveled route terminates there. The desert branch preserves the sharp lexical boundary between deliverance and destruction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Distributed human control remains inside encompassing possession and knowledge, so attempted escape ends in return, report, and a destination with no external refuge.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct and indirect; 24:57 denies escape and names fire as refuge and destination, while 24:64 encloses heavens and earth within divine possession, return, report, and knowledge.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Owned dependents and keys earlier in P4 activate latent sovereignty branches; open-earth flight, failed outrunning, desert ambiguity, shelter, fire, and return turn final accountability into a closed trajectory.

parent_channels.name: S1. [P3 24:35-46] Sovereignty Converges in a Single Destination
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The upper and lower worlds belong to one sovereign, and every trajectory converges on that same authority as its endpoint and place of settled return.
parent_channels.active_motifs: political and divine sovereignty `quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`; sky and all that rises overhead `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; earth as the lower field `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; becoming and reaching a final outcome `quranic:root_000897:B001/m01`; destination as a settled place of return `quranic:root_000897:B007/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 24:42 `وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ`
parent_channels.synthesis: Spatial totality and directional convergence form one complete scene. Sovereignty holds both vertical poles, while `المصير` turns every distinct movement toward one end and, lexically, one place of settlement.

parent_channels.name: S2. [Whole-surah] A Covered Pot on Three Hearthstones
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A household fire is fed, a cooking pot is balanced on a third hearthstone, fat melts within it, and a heat-cloth and lid control removal and closure.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fire consuming its fuel `quranic:root_000043:B005/m01`; third hearthstone completing the pot support `quranic:root_000203:B007/m01`; cooking pot `quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`; melted fat rising over the pot `quranic:root_000064:B006/m01`; cloth for lowering the hot pot `quranic:root_000248:B007/m01`; lid placed over the vessel `quranic:root_001294:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Fuel, support, vessel, food, handling tool, and cover cooperate in one domestic operation. The scene materializes 24:61's permission to eat from houses as a meal produced inside a working household, while the lid and heat-cloth reinforce the surah's primary concern with controlled access to interiors rather than exposure without mediation.

parent_channels.name: S3. [Whole-surah] Tanning a Hide into a Protective Shelter
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A stiff untanned hide is treated with bark and measured tanning agent, joined to another panel by stitching, and raised as a leather cover.
parent_channels.active_motifs: stiff untanned hide `quranic:root_000313:B002/m01`; flayed hide as workable material `quranic:root_000253:B005/m01`; salam bark or leaves used for tanning `quranic:root_000737:B008/m01`; one or two small doses of tanning agent `quranic:root_001533:B007/m01`; stitching hide to hide `quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`; leather dome or protective cover `quranic:root_000156:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The motifs form a single material transformation: exposed hide begins hard, receives a plant agent in measured doses, is sewn into joined panels, and becomes shelter. This lexically materializes the surah's movement from skin and exposure toward garment, veil, house, and permission, reframing privacy as protection that must be made and maintained around vulnerable surfaces.

parent_channels.name: S4. [Whole-surah] Drawing Real Water from a Well
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An open well is fitted with an upright pulley support; a long twisted rope lowers a shaped bucket, and the recovered water is carried in a skin so a traveler or camp can sustain itself.
parent_channels.active_motifs: open well `quranic:root_001248:B007/m01`; upright support for the well pulley `quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`; long tightly twisted bucket rope `quranic:root_000796:B002/m02`; shaped or crooked drawing bucket `quranic:root_001372:B002/m01`; water appearing and filling the well `quranic:root_001458:B002/m01`; waterskin used to draw or carry water `quranic:root_001212:B009/m01`; survival water by which a traveler or camp controls its condition `quranic:root_001444:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Unlike the mirage at 24:39, this water does not merely occupy the eye's target. It appears in a known source, survives contact, and becomes usable only through a fitted chain of support, rope, bucket, and carrying vessel. The scene supports the primary mirage reading by separating imagined provision from provision actually obtained, and it materializes water as the condition by which mobile and settled life can hold together.

parent_channels.name: S5. [Whole-surah] Raising the Wedding House and Feeding Guests
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A marriage is realized through entry under a wedding cover, the couple becomes associated with a marriage house, and food is prepared for the occasion and its arriving guests.
parent_channels.active_motifs: entering marriage under an erected wedding cover `quranic:root_000156:B006/m01`; marriage house `quranic:root_000166:B010/m01`; feeding at a marriage or house-building `quranic:root_001409:B005/m01`; prepared food and provisions for an arriving guest `quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene gives architecture, bodily entry, and public feeding to the transition commanded at 24:32. It materializes marriage as the formation of an inhabited and received household, not only a change in legal status; the surah's later rules of house entry and shared eating then govern the social unit that the rite establishes.

parent_channels.name: S6. [Whole-surah] A Horse Race Fixes the Order at the Finish
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A horse bursts ahead, another closes on the leader, the first reaches the finish, and the next two horses take second and third place.
parent_channels.active_motifs: racehorse bursting out ahead `quranic:root_000736:B009/m01`; catching the one who preceded `quranic:root_000175:B002/m01`; first horse reaching and controlling the finish `quranic:root_001684:B012/m01`; second horse with its head at the winner's flank `quranic:root_000879:B006/m01`; third horse completing the first three `quranic:root_000203:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Burst, pursuit, arrival, and ordinal placement make one complete race rather than a loose animal cluster. The scene materializes the surah's contrast between following a course, turning away, and attaining success: the obedient claim of 24:47-55 is tested by sustained movement to the finish, not by the force of an oath at the start.

parent_channels.name: S7. [Whole-surah] Casting Numbered Gaming Arrows for Shares
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Named fifth and sixth gaming arrows are cast from the hand, shares are allotted by their outcome, and one player wins by depriving another of the expected stake.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fifth gaming arrow `quranic:root_001533:B016/m01`; sixth gaming arrow `quranic:root_000867:B011/m01`; casting gaming arrows from the hand `quranic:root_001192:B004/m01`; separating and allotting shares `quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`; gambling victory that deprives an opponent of the expected stake `quranic:root_000313:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Numbered implements and divided shares give the game an appearance of measured procedure, but the allocation comes from a cast and ends in competitive deprivation. This usefully pressures the surah's repeated counts, oath sequences, and apportioned liabilities: lawful judgment cannot be produced like a gaming lot, because its numbers require testimony, accountable speech, and known action.

parent_channels.name: S8. [Whole-surah] A Sea Vessel Heels and Takes Water
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Seafarers embark in a large vessel, a small tender follows it, the main ship heels to one side, and water enters the hull.
parent_channels.active_motifs: embarking on the sea `quranic:root_000086:B009/m01`; large seagoing fighting ship `quranic:root_000101:B007/m01`; small tender following a ship `quranic:root_001212:B011/m01`; ship heeling to one side `quranic:root_000263:B001/m01`; water entering the vessel `quranic:root_001458:B002/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: The vessel supplies an operational scene inside the deep-sea darkness of 24:40. A heeling hull and incoming water threaten passage while the following tender remains dependent on the ship it serves. This materializes layered darkness as failed navigation and unstable refuge, reinforcing the primary contrast between light-given orientation and a condition in which even the conveyance cannot reliably hold its course.

parent_channels.name: X1. Assertion Becomes Credible Through Embodied Proof
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A claim cannot authorize itself; credibility emerges when assertion passes through a bounded evidentiary procedure and becomes answerable to bodies or observable conduct.
parent_channels.synthesis: The evidentiary role moves progressively outward. Direct observers first convert knowledge into testimony, and the exceptional oath procedure binds speakers through a balanced form when observers are unavailable. The body then supplies testimony about its own deeds, while the later obedience scene makes conduct, not oath volume, the decisive disclosure. The bridge preserves the difference between a legally calibrated oath and an oath used to postpone performance.

parent_channels.name: X2. Protected Interiors Require Controlled Permeability
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An interior remains protective and productive when its boundary selects what may enter, leave, or become visible rather than functioning as either total exposure or total closure.
parent_channels.synthesis: The shared scene contains an interior, a boundary, something that may cross it, and an operation that governs the crossing. P1 identifies the protected interest and the damage of breach. P2 differentiates recognition, permission, attenuation, guarding, and garment closure. The lamp apparatus shows that enclosure can concentrate and transmit a good without surrendering containment. P4 then makes access responsive to time and maturity and uses greeting to restore safety after entry. The whole-surah invariant is controlled transmission through a maintained boundary.

parent_channels.name: X3. Orientation Becomes Track, Route, Choice, and Destination
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Moral and epistemic orientation becomes legible by generating a trace, entering a route, producing approach or withdrawal, and terminating at an accountable destination.
parent_channels.synthesis: A report first acquires a heading in cognition. Repeated imitation extends that heading into a path, while remote crooked pull explains how deviation can persist across distance. Light and manifest signs then make an alternative course visible and traversable. At judgment, voiced orientation is tested by actual approach, withdrawal, or obedient movement. Return, report, and final refuge supply the endpoint, so direction is never merely metaphorical position; it is a course whose successive acts arrive somewhere.

parent_channels.name: X4. Bounded Delivery Reverses Uncontrolled Relay
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Responsible transmission joins source, payload, placement, clarification, carrier limit, and receiver liability; circulation without those boundaries multiplies speech while severing it from knowledge.
parent_channels.synthesis: Both rumor and instruction move through a social field, but movement alone does not make them equivalent. Rumor is received and reissued before a knowledge-bearing pause, then expands through overflow and reinforcement. Revelation arrives from a named source, is placed, made visible, and clarified. The messenger carries that payload only to its assigned boundary, and the audience retains the burden of response. The later distinction between the messenger's call and peer-calling completes the reversal from uncontrolled circulation to accountable conveyance.

parent_channels.name: S9. [P2 24:21-34] Bast Fiber Becomes Dense Cloth
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Bast fiber is cleaned into usable strands, spun under stable rotation, woven and twisted, and compacted into strong cloth.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bast fiber prepared as strands for twisting `quranic:root_001355:B009/m01`; spindle rotated until the twist and whorl hold firm `quranic:root_000469:B007/m01`; skilled weaving, spinning, and twisting `quranic:root_000217:B007/m01`; cloth strengthened by abundant dense yarn `quranic:root_000043:B012/m01`; tightly secured weave `quranic:root_000347:B010/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Preparation, rotation, twist, interlacing, and density form one manufacture sequence. The scene materializes the veil and garment operations of 24:31 as a made boundary whose protective strength depends on many aligned strands, reframing modest covering as maintained material structure rather than an undifferentiated surface.

parent_channels.name: S10. [P3 24:35-46] Water Tests and Seals a Stitched Skin
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Two hide panels are stitched into a waterskin, water is introduced to swell the stitch holes, leaks expose defects, and a sound seam closes around the retained liquid.
parent_channels.active_motifs: stitching the two sides and upper seam of a waterskin `quranic:root_000438:B011/m01`; water leaking and dripping through stitch holes `quranic:root_000691:B003/m01`; filling the skin so stitch holes swell shut and defects become visible `quranic:root_000691:B004/m01`; closed stitching that retains water `quranic:root_001284:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Water is both cargo and test medium: contact pressurizes the new vessel, reveals faulty joins, and helps a sound seam close. This supports the mirage contrast at 24:39 by giving real water consequences that an optical substitute cannot produce. A mirage cannot swell a seam, disclose a leak, or remain available inside a container.

parent_channels.name: S11. [P2 24:21-34] Cleaving Soil Begins a Delayed Harvest
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A cultivator splits the ground, places and covers grain, irrigates the field, waits for ears to emerge, and carries the cut crop to the threshing floor.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cereal grain and seed `quranic:root_000286:B001/m01`; farmer cleaving soil for planting `quranic:root_001175:B003/m01`; burying seed beneath earth `quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`; irrigating land and crop with lifted water `quranic:root_000751:B001/m01`; grain putting forth an ear `quranic:root_000672:B008/m01`; carrying harvested crop to the threshing floor `quranic:root_000582:B006/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The agricultural sense of `فلاح` expands the success named at 24:31 into a causal sequence. Flourishing begins with an opening cut, passes through hidden seed and sustained watering, and becomes visible only in ear and harvest. The scene also materializes the provision of 24:38 as an outcome prepared through ordered work rather than an immediate possession.

parent_channels.name: S12. [P3 24:35-46] Call, Orientation, and Posture Complete the Prayer Rite
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A repeated call summons worshippers, they face a common direction, open the prayer with its first declaration, stand, and lower themselves into prostration.
parent_channels.active_motifs: repeated prayer call or adhan `quranic:root_000209:B004/m01`; imperative summons to come to prayer `quranic:root_000383:B009/m01`; qibla as the faced prayer direction `quranic:root_001198:B005/m01`; opening prayer with the first takbir `quranic:root_001124:B002/m01`; bodily standing in prayer `quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`; prostrating with weight supported on palms or elbows `quranic:root_000263:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Voice, shared orientation, formal opening, and successive postures make prayer an ordered communal act. The scene materializes `إقام الصلاة` at 24:37 and 24:56, while the prayer markers in 24:58 become times generated by a performed rite rather than bare labels on a household clock.

parent_channels.name: S13. [P3 24:35-46] A House Rises from Foundation, Mud Brick, and Timber
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Workers establish a base, work mud brick into joined walls, fit interlocking timber supports, and lay crossbeams and a lintel across the openings.
parent_channels.active_motifs: foundation and structural base `quranic:root_000038:B001/m01`; manual workers engaged in digging and mud work `quranic:root_001046:B006/m01`; adobe or mud brick put to use in construction `quranic:root_001046:B002/m01`; building a house or wall by joining parts `quranic:root_000156:B001/m01`; interlocking timber that carries or braces a house and door `quranic:root_000777:B004/m01`; roof crossbeams and door lintel laid transversely `quranic:root_001001:B013/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Foundation, labor, earthen material, joined wall, timber frame, and transverse members form a complete building operation. This materializes the houses authorized to rise at 24:36 and the houses regulated elsewhere in the surah: permission, privacy, worship, and hospitality operate through an architecture that has been deliberately made load-bearing.

parent_channels.name: S14. [P4 24:47-64] Repeated Visits Carry a Patient toward Recovery
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Illness produces pain, attendants care for the patient, visitors return repeatedly, and the patient's condition moves through convalescence into recovery.
parent_channels.active_motifs: illness and bodily pain `quranic:root_000814:B003/m01`; tending a patient well to remove illness `quranic:root_001415:B003/m01`; repeated visitation of the sick `quranic:root_001058:B005/m01`; convalescence and improving condition `quranic:root_001397:B012/m01`; recovery and release from sickness `quranic:root_000099:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The sick person named in 24:61 activates a social process, not only an exemption. Care requires someone to remain with the patient and others to return; improvement precedes full recovery. The scene materializes inclusive household eating as a network of presence and care capable of carrying bodily weakness back into common life.

parent_channels.name: S15. [P3 24:35-46] A Camel Auction Escalates the Market
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A camel is displayed for sale, prospective buyers raise one another's bids, and demand turns the gathering into a thriving market.
parent_channels.active_motifs: displaying an object for sale `quranic:root_000169:B002/m01`; she-camel selling briskly when offered `quranic:root_000176:B003/m01`; competitive bidding that asks for successive increases `quranic:root_000657:B004/m01`; market rising into active demand `quranic:root_001273:B018/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Visible livestock, rival buyers, rising bids, and collective demand supply a concrete mechanism for the attention pressure resisted at 24:37. The adjacent `يَزِيدَهُم` at 24:38 is thereby reframed against another kind of increase: market escalation raises a price through competition, while divine increase follows worship that the market failed to capture and exceeds ordinary account.

parent_channels.name: S16. [P3 24:35-46] Leaving Milk in the Udder Preserves the Next Yield
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A kneeling camel is milked in the morning, a remnant is deliberately left in the udder, milk returns during the interval, and the yield is collected without exhausting its source.
parent_channels.active_motifs: morning milk drawn from a kneeling camel `quranic:root_000109:B007/m01`; milk left in the udder to call forth what follows `quranic:root_000478:B003/m01`; milk returning between two milkings `quranic:root_001188:B006/m01`; abundant or successive milk flow `quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`; small leather vessel for milk `quranic:root_000814:B004/m01`; milk depleted by overmilking or adulteration `quranic:root_000268:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Provision appears as renewable yield governed by interval and restraint. Leaving a remnant helps produce the next flow, whereas extracting to exhaustion destroys continuity. The scene materializes provision at 24:38 and usefully pressures the coercive worldly extraction forbidden at 24:33: immediate seizure and sustained productivity follow opposite operating rules.

parent_channels.name: S17. [P4 24:47-64] A Fitted Pack Becomes Injury When Overloaded
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A load is secured to a pack animal with carrying gear and a belly girth, protective tack distributes contact, and excess weight converts transport into bodily injury.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a visible load borne on a back, head, animal, or message carrier `quranic:root_000357:B001/m01`; carrying equipment and pack mount `quranic:root_000357:B006/m01`; belly girth securing the saddle or pack `quranic:root_000128:B006/m01`; protective saddle that avoids sores or rough contact `quranic:root_001677:B003/m01`; loading an animal beyond its capacity `quranic:root_000268:B003/m01`; camel ribs broken by a heavy load `quranic:root_000263:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The messenger's bounded burden at 24:54 becomes a mechanics of fit and capacity. A load needs equipment, secure attachment, and protection at contact points; piling the audience's liability back onto the carrier would turn conveyance into overload. The injury outcome materially reinforces the verse's distribution of distinct burdens.

parent_channels.name: S18. [P2 24:21-34] Ground Aromatics Travel Beyond the Line of Sight
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Aromatic materials are ground on a broad stone, blended with saffron into perfume, applied as scent and color, and released as a perceptible fragrance.
parent_channels.active_motifs: aromatic substances used in preparing perfume `quranic:root_001190:B005/m01`; broad grinding stone for pounding aromatics `quranic:root_000879:B008/m01`; saffron or saffron-mixed perfume `quranic:root_000974:B011/m01`; blended perfume applied as an anointing `quranic:root_000434:B010/m01`; perfume and color applied to a woman's face `quranic:root_000438:B006/m01`; fragrance and the act of perfuming `quranic:root_001002:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Ingredient, tool, mixture, application, and emitted trace form one cosmetic craft. The scene usefully pressures the gaze and adornment rules of 24:30-31: adornment can project beyond a covered visual surface through scent, so controlled display concerns the transmission of a crafted presence, not only an object already inside another person's line of sight.
